scripts.title: Button that opens a door
scripts.where: Put this Script inside a Model in Workspace that holds two parts named Button and Door.
scripts.about: Clicking, tapping or stepping on the button opens the door for a few seconds.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local OPEN_TIME = 5 -- seconds the door stays open
local PRESSED_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0) -- button color while the door is open

local model = script.Parent
local button = model:WaitForChild("Button")
local door = model:WaitForChild("Door")

-- Add a ClickDetector so the button can be clicked or tapped
local clickDetector = button:FindFirstChildOfClass("ClickDetector") or Instance.new("ClickDetector")
clickDetector.Parent = button

local buttonColor = button.Color
local doorTransparency = door.Transparency
local isOpen = false

local function openDoor()
	if isOpen then
		return
	end
	isOpen = true
	button.Color = PRESSED_COLOR
	door.CanCollide = false
	door.Transparency = 0.8

	task.wait(OPEN_TIME)

	door.CanCollide = true
	door.Transparency = doorTransparency
	button.Color = buttonColor
	isOpen = false
end

-- Click or tap the button
clickDetector.MouseClick:Connect(openDoor)

-- Or step on the button
button.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	if Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent) then
		openDoor()
	end
end)

scripts.title: Door that opens when touched
scripts.where: Put this Script inside the door Part (make it Anchored).
scripts.about: The door opens when a player bumps into it, then closes again after a few seconds.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local OPEN_TIME = 3 -- seconds the door stays open
local OPEN_TRANSPARENCY = 0.7 -- how see-through it is when open (1 = invisible)

local door = script.Parent
local closedTransparency = door.Transparency
local isOpen = false

door.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	-- Only open for players, and not if it's already open
	if isOpen or not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent) then
		return
	end
	isOpen = true

	-- Open: you can walk through now
	door.CanCollide = false
	door.Transparency = OPEN_TRANSPARENCY

	task.wait(OPEN_TIME)

	-- Close again
	door.CanCollide = true
	door.Transparency = closedTransparency
	isOpen = false
end)

scripts.title: Key door
scripts.where: Put this Script inside the door Part, and make a Tool named Key (with a Handle part) that players can get.
scripts.about: The door only opens for players who have the Key tool.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change these!
local KEY_NAME = "Key" -- the exact name of your key Tool
local OPEN_TIME = 3 -- seconds the door stays open
local USE_UP_KEY = false -- true = the key disappears after opening the door

local door = script.Parent
local closedTransparency = door.Transparency
local isOpen = false

-- Find the player who touched the door (even if it was their tool or hat)
local function getPlayer(hit)
	local model = hit.Parent
	local player = model and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
	if not player and model and model.Parent then
		player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model.Parent)
	end
	return player
end

-- Look for the key in their hand or their backpack
local function findKey(player)
	local character = player.Character
	local backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
	return (character and character:FindFirstChild(KEY_NAME))
		or (backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild(KEY_NAME))
end

door.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	if isOpen then
		return
	end
	local player = getPlayer(hit)
	local key = player and findKey(player)
	if not key then
		return -- no key, no entry!
	end

	isOpen = true
	if USE_UP_KEY then
		key:Destroy()
	end
	door.CanCollide = false
	door.Transparency = 0.7

	task.wait(OPEN_TIME)
	door.CanCollide = true
	door.Transparency = closedTransparency
	isOpen = false
end)

scripts.title: Team-only door
scripts.where: Put this Script inside the door Part, make sure you have Teams (in the Teams service), and set TEAM_NAME below.
scripts.about: Players on one team can walk right through the door, but everyone else is blocked.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local PhysicsService = game:GetService("PhysicsService")

-- Settings: change this to your team's exact name!
local TEAM_NAME = "Red"

local door = script.Parent
local doorGroup = "TeamDoor_" .. TEAM_NAME
local memberGroup = "TeamMembers_" .. TEAM_NAME

-- Collision groups: team members and this door don't bump into each other
for _, groupName in ipairs({ doorGroup, memberGroup }) do
	if not PhysicsService:IsCollisionGroupRegistered(groupName) then
		PhysicsService:RegisterCollisionGroup(groupName)
	end
end
PhysicsService:CollisionGroupSetCollidable(doorGroup, memberGroup, false)
door.CollisionGroup = doorGroup

local function isOnTeam(player)
	return player.Team ~= nil and player.Team.Name == TEAM_NAME
end

-- Put a body part in the right group
local function updatePart(player, part)
	if not part:IsA("BasePart") then
		return
	end
	if isOnTeam(player) then
		part.CollisionGroup = memberGroup
	elseif part.CollisionGroup == memberGroup then
		part.CollisionGroup = "Default"
	end
end

local function updateCharacter(player, character)
	for _, part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		updatePart(player, part)
	end
end

local function onPlayerAdded(player)
	local function onCharacter(character)
		updateCharacter(player, character)
		character.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(part)
			updatePart(player, part)
		end)
	end
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacter)
	if player.Character then
		onCharacter(player.Character)
	end
	-- Switching teams? Update right away
	player:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Team"):Connect(function()
		if player.Character then
			updateCharacter(player, player.Character)
		end
	end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
	onPlayerAdded(player)
end

scripts.title: Coins on screen
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript inside a TextLabel in a ScreenGui in StarterGui (you also need the Leaderstats with saving script).
scripts.about: Shows the player's coins on the screen and updates it when the number changes.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change these!
local STAT_NAME = "Coins" -- must match your leaderstats name
local PREFIX = "Coins: " -- text shown before the number

local label = script.Parent
local player = Players.LocalPlayer

-- Wait for the leaderstats made by the server
local leaderstats = player:WaitForChild("leaderstats")
local stat = leaderstats:WaitForChild(STAT_NAME)

local function update()
	label.Text = PREFIX .. tostring(stat.Value)

stat:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(update)

scripts.title: Shop button
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript inside a TextButton in a ScreenGui in StarterGui, and also add the Shop (server part) script and a RemoteEvent named BuyItem in ReplicatedStorage.
scripts.about: Tapping the button asks the server to buy an item, then shows if it worked.
scripts.code:
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

-- Settings: change this to the item this button buys
local ITEM_NAME = "Sword" -- must match a name in the Shop (server part) PRICES list
local MESSAGE_TIME = 1.5 -- seconds the "Bought!" message stays

local button = script.Parent
local buyItem = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("BuyItem")
local normalText = button.Text
local normalColor = button.BackgroundColor3
local messageNumber = 0

-- Tapping or clicking the button asks the server to buy (the server checks the coins)
button.Activated:Connect(function()
	buyItem:FireServer(ITEM_NAME)
end)

-- The server answers: did it work?
buyItem.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(itemName, success, message)
	if itemName ~= ITEM_NAME then
		return -- this answer is for a different button
	end
	messageNumber = messageNumber + 1
	local myNumber = messageNumber

	button.Text = message
	if success then
		button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 200, 90) -- green
	else
		button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 70, 70) -- red
	end

	-- Go back to normal after a moment
	task.delay(MESSAGE_TIME, function()
		if myNumber == messageNumber then
			button.Text = normalText
			button.BackgroundColor3 = normalColor
		end
	end)
end)

scripts.title: Round timer with intermission
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService; add a normal Part named RoundSpawn where rounds start (not a SpawnLocation), and use the Round timer text script to show the time.
scripts.about: Runs an intermission countdown, sends everyone into a round, then brings them back to the lobby, forever.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local INTERMISSION = 15 -- seconds in the lobby between rounds
local ROUND_TIME = 60 -- seconds each round lasts
local MIN_PLAYERS = 1 -- players needed to start (use 2 for a real game)

-- The text everyone sees, shared in ReplicatedStorage
local status = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Status")
if not status then
	status = Instance.new("StringValue")
	status.Name = "Status"
	status.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
end

-- Count down one second at a time
local function countdown(text, seconds)
	for i = seconds, 1, -1 do
		status.Value = text .. i
		task.wait(1)
	end
end

while true do
	-- Wait until there are enough players
	while #Players:GetPlayers() < MIN_PLAYERS do
		status.Value = "Waiting for players..."
		task.wait(1)
	end

	countdown("Intermission: ", INTERMISSION)

	-- Round start: send everyone to RoundSpawn (spread out a little)
	local roundSpawn = workspace:FindFirstChild("RoundSpawn")
	if roundSpawn then
		for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			local character = player.Character
			if character then
				local offset = Vector3.new(math.random(-5, 5), 5, math.random(-5, 5))
				character:PivotTo(CFrame.new(roundSpawn.Position + offset))
			end
		end
	end

	countdown("Round: ", ROUND_TIME)

	-- Round over: respawn everyone back in the lobby
	status.Value = "Round over!"
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		player:LoadCharacter()
	end
	task.wait(3)
end

scripts.title: Win pad
scripts.where: Put this Script inside the finish Part at the end of your obby or race, and add a Part named Lobby in Workspace if you want winners sent back there.
scripts.about: Touching the finish gives the player a Win on the leaderboard and sends them back to the lobby.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change these!
local LOBBY_NAME = "Lobby" -- winners get sent to a part with this name (if it exists)
local COOLDOWN = 5 -- seconds before the same player can win again

local pad = script.Parent
local recent = {} -- players who just won

pad.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	local character = hit.Parent
	local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
	if not player or recent[player] then
		return
	end
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		return
	end
	recent[player] = true

	-- Find (or make) the Wins number on the leaderboard
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if not leaderstats then
		leaderstats = Instance.new("Folder")
		leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"
		leaderstats.Parent = player
	end
	local wins = leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Wins")
	if not wins then
		wins = Instance.new("IntValue")
		wins.Name = "Wins"
		wins.Parent = leaderstats
	end
	wins.Value = wins.Value + 1

	-- Send the winner back to the lobby
	local lobby = workspace:FindFirstChild(LOBBY_NAME)
	if lobby and lobby:IsA("BasePart") then
		character:PivotTo(CFrame.new(lobby.Position + Vector3.new(0, lobby.Size.Y / 2 + 3, 0)))
	end

	task.delay(COOLDOWN, function()
		recent[player] = nil
	end)
end)

scripts.title: Clock with moving hands
scripts.where: Put this Script inside a Model with an Anchored Part named Center (its front face is the clock face) and Anchored Parts named HourHand, MinuteHand and SecondHand (each long along Y).
scripts.about: Turns the clock hands to show the real time of day, ticking every second.
scripts.code:
-- Settings: change this to your time zone! (hours away from UTC, like -5 for New York, 1 for Paris)
local TIME_ZONE = -5

local model = script.Parent
local center = model:WaitForChild("Center")
local hands = {
	{ part = model:WaitForChild("HourHand"), depth = 0.2 },
	{ part = model:WaitForChild("MinuteHand"), depth = 0.3 },
	{ part = model:WaitForChild("SecondHand"), depth = 0.4 },
}

-- Point a hand at an angle (0 = 12 o'clock) with one end at the middle of the clock
local function placeHand(hand, fraction)
	local angle = fraction * math.pi * 2
	local part = hand.part
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CFrame = center.CFrame
		* CFrame.new(0, 0, -hand.depth) -- sit a bit in front of the face so you can see it
		* CFrame.Angles(0, 0, angle) -- turn clockwise
		* CFrame.new(0, part.Size.Y / 2, 0) -- move out so the end sits in the middle
end

while true do
	local now = os.date("!*t", os.time() + TIME_ZONE * 3600)
	local seconds = now.sec
	local minutes = now.min + seconds / 60
	local hours = (now.hour % 12) + minutes / 60
	placeHand(hands[1], hours / 12)
	placeHand(hands[2], minutes / 60)
	placeHand(hands[3], seconds / 60)
	task.wait(1)
end

scripts.title: Conveyor belt
scripts.where: Put this Script inside a flat Part; it pushes players toward the part's Front side (spin the part around to change the direction).
scripts.about: Pushes anything standing on the part along, like a conveyor belt.
scripts.code:
-- Settings: change this number!
local SPEED = 10 -- studs per second (bigger = faster, negative = backwards)

local belt = script.Parent
belt.Anchored = true -- the belt itself stays still

-- The belt "pretends" to move, so things on top slide along
local function updateBelt()
	belt.AssemblyLinearVelocity = belt.CFrame.LookVector * SPEED
end

updateBelt()
-- If you turn the part around while playing, the push direction follows
belt:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CFrame"):Connect(updateBelt)

scripts.title: Domino run
scripts.where: Put this Script inside an Anchored Part on the floor; its front face points where the line of dominoes goes.
scripts.about: Click the part to set up a fresh line of dominoes and knock the first one over.
scripts.code:
-- Settings: change these numbers!
local COUNT = 30 -- how many dominoes
local GAP = 2.5 -- studs between dominoes
local SIZE = Vector3.new(3, 5, 0.6)

local base = script.Parent
local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
folder.Name = "Dominoes"
folder.Parent = workspace

local clicker = Instance.new("ClickDetector")
clicker.MaxActivationDistance = 30
clicker.Parent = base

local function buildAndPush()
	folder:ClearAllChildren()
	local first
	for i = 1, COUNT do
		local domino = Instance.new("Part")
		domino.Size = SIZE
		-- Line them up in front of the base, standing on the floor
		local offset = CFrame.new(0, SIZE.Y / 2 - base.Size.Y / 2, -(i * GAP))
		domino.CFrame = base.CFrame * offset
		domino.Color = Color3.fromHSV((i / COUNT) % 1, 0.7, 1) -- rainbow!
		domino.Parent = folder
		domino:SetNetworkOwner(nil)
		first = first or domino
	end
	task.wait(1)
	-- Tip the first one over by pushing its top forward
	local push = base.CFrame.LookVector * first.AssemblyMass * 15
	first:ApplyImpulseAtPosition(push, first.Position + Vector3.new(0, SIZE.Y / 2, 0))
end

local busy = false
clicker.MouseClick:Connect(function()
	if busy then
		return
	end
	busy = true
	buildAndPush()
	task.wait(3)
	busy = false
end)

scripts.title: Drawbridge
scripts.where: Put this Script inside the bridge Part (not anchored) and add an Anchored Part named BridgeHinge at the end of the bridge, turned so its red X arrow runs along the hinge line.
scripts.about: Press E on the bridge hinge to raise or lower the bridge with a smooth physics hinge.
scripts.code:
-- Settings: change these numbers!
local UP_ANGLE = 80 -- degrees when raised (use -80 if it swings the wrong way)
local SWING_SPEED = 1 -- radians per second

local bridge = script.Parent
local hingePart = bridge.Parent:WaitForChild("BridgeHinge")
hingePart.Anchored = true

local a0 = Instance.new("Attachment")
a0.Parent = hingePart
local a1 = Instance.new("Attachment")
a1.Parent = bridge
a1.WorldCFrame = a0.WorldCFrame -- both attachments sit in the same spot

-- A Servo hinge turns to TargetAngle and holds it there
local hinge = Instance.new("HingeConstraint")
hinge.Attachment0 = a0
hinge.Attachment1 = a1
hinge.ActuatorType = Enum.ActuatorType.Servo
hinge.ServoMaxTorque = 1e9
hinge.AngularSpeed = SWING_SPEED
hinge.TargetAngle = 0
hinge.Parent = bridge

bridge.Anchored = false
bridge:SetNetworkOwner(nil)

local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
prompt.ActionText = "Raise bridge"
prompt.ObjectText = "Drawbridge"
prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 15
prompt.Parent = hingePart

prompt.Triggered:Connect(function()
	if hinge.TargetAngle == 0 then
		hinge.TargetAngle = UP_ANGLE
		prompt.ActionText = "Lower bridge"
	else
		hinge.TargetAngle = 0
		prompt.ActionText = "Raise bridge"
	end
end)

scripts.title: Elevator between two floors
scripts.where: Put this Script inside the elevator floor Part (it can be Anchored, the script fixes it) at the bottom floor.
scripts.about: Press E on the elevator to ride it up or down; it is physics based so players ride smoothly.
scripts.code:
-- Settings: change these numbers!
local HEIGHT = 30 -- how far up the top floor is (studs)
local SPEED = 8 -- studs per second

local platform = script.Parent

-- An invisible anchored part holds the "rail" the platform slides on
local base = Instance.new("Part")
base.Name = "ElevatorBase"
base.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
base.Transparency = 1
base.CanCollide = false
base.Anchored = true
base.CFrame = platform.CFrame
base.Parent = platform.Parent

-- Turn the attachments so their main (X) axis points straight up
local a0 = Instance.new("Attachment")
a0.CFrame = CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
a0.Parent = base
local a1 = Instance.new("Attachment")
a1.CFrame = CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
a1.Parent = platform

-- A PrismaticConstraint slides along one line; Servo means "go to TargetPosition"
local slider = Instance.new("PrismaticConstraint")
slider.Attachment0 = a0
slider.Attachment1 = a1
slider.ActuatorType = Enum.ActuatorType.Servo
slider.Speed = SPEED
slider.ServoMaxForce = 1e8 -- strong enough to lift lots of players
slider.TargetPosition = 0
slider.Parent = platform

platform.Anchored = false
platform:SetNetworkOwner(nil)

-- Press E to go up or down
local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
prompt.ActionText = "Go up"
prompt.ObjectText = "Elevator"
prompt.Parent = platform

prompt.Triggered:Connect(function()
	if slider.TargetPosition == 0 then
		slider.TargetPosition = HEIGHT
		prompt.ActionText = "Go down"
	else
		slider.TargetPosition = 0
		prompt.ActionText = "Go up"
	end
end)

scripts.title: Ferris wheel motor
scripts.where: Put this Script inside the wheel Model, with the axle Part named Axle (Anchored, its red X arrow pointing through the middle of the wheel) and every other wheel part welded to a Part named Hub that is NOT anchored.
scripts.about: Uses a HingeConstraint motor to turn the wheel with real physics, so seats and riders go round with it.
scripts.code:
-- Settings: change these numbers!
local SPEED = 0.3 -- turning speed (radians per second, try 0.1 to 2)
local TORQUE = 1e9 -- how strong the motor is

local model = script.Parent
local axle = model:WaitForChild("Axle")
local hub = model:WaitForChild("Hub")
axle.Anchored = true
hub.Anchored = false

-- Attachments at the center of each part; the hinge spins around their X axis
local a0 = Instance.new("Attachment")
a0.Parent = axle
local a1 = Instance.new("Attachment")
a1.Parent = hub
-- Move the hub attachment so it lines up with the axle
a1.WorldCFrame = a0.WorldCFrame

local hinge = Instance.new("HingeConstraint")
hinge.Attachment0 = a0
hinge.Attachment1 = a1
hinge.ActuatorType = Enum.ActuatorType.Motor
hinge.AngularVelocity = SPEED
hinge.MotorMaxTorque = TORQUE
hinge.MotorMaxAcceleration = 1 -- start and stop gently
hinge.Parent = hub

-- Let the server run the physics so it looks the same for everyone
hub:SetNetworkOwner(nil)

scripts.title: Flipper arm that launches you
scripts.where: Put this Script inside a flat unanchored Part (the flipper) and add an Anchored Part named FlipperPivot at one end, turned so its red X arrow runs along the hinge line.
scripts.about: Every few seconds the flipper snaps up with a physics hinge and flings anything standing on it.
scripts.code:
-- Settings: change these numbers!
local FLIP_ANGLE = 60 -- degrees it flips up (use -60 if it flips the wrong way)
local FLIP_SPEED = 25 -- radians per second, very fast
local WAIT_TIME = 3 -- seconds between flips

local flipper = script.Parent
local pivot = flipper.Parent:WaitForChild("FlipperPivot")
pivot.Anchored = true
flipper.Anchored = false

local a0 = Instance.new("Attachment")
a0.Parent = pivot
local a1 = Instance.new("Attachment")
a1.Parent = flipper
a1.WorldCFrame = a0.WorldCFrame

local hinge = Instance.new("HingeConstraint")
hinge.Attachment0 = a0
hinge.Attachment1 = a1
hinge.ActuatorType = Enum.ActuatorType.Servo
hinge.ServoMaxTorque = 1e10
hinge.AngularSpeed = FLIP_SPEED
hinge.TargetAngle = 0
hinge.Parent = flipper

flipper:SetNetworkOwner(nil)

while true do
	task.wait(WAIT_TIME)
	hinge.AngularSpeed = FLIP_SPEED
	hinge.TargetAngle = FLIP_ANGLE -- SNAP up!
	task.wait(0.5)
	hinge.AngularSpeed = 2 -- come back down slowly
	hinge.TargetAngle = 0
end

scripts.title: Floating bobbing part
scripts.where: Put this Script inside an Anchored Part (great for floating islands, gems or boats on water).
scripts.about: Makes the part float gently up and down and slowly turn, like it is hovering.
scripts.code:
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local BOB_HEIGHT = 1.5 -- studs up and down
local BOB_TIME = 2 -- seconds to go up once
local SPIN = true -- also turn slowly?

local part = script.Parent
part.Anchored = true
local start = part.CFrame

-- A tween that goes up, then reverses back down, forever (-1 means repeat forever)
local info = TweenInfo.new(BOB_TIME, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, true)

if not SPIN then
	TweenService:Create(part, info, { CFrame = start + Vector3.new(0, BOB_HEIGHT, 0) }):Play()
	return
end

-- With spinning we work out the position ourselves every frame
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	local t = os.clock()
	local up = math.sin(t * math.pi / BOB_TIME) * BOB_HEIGHT / 2
	part.CFrame = start * CFrame.new(0, up, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, t * 0.5, 0)
end)

scripts.title: Hovering part you can push
scripts.where: Put this Script inside an unanchored Part you want to float in the air.
scripts.about: The part floats in place with physics, so players can bump it around and it drifts back home.
scripts.code:
-- Settings: change these numbers!
local HOVER_HEIGHT = 0 -- extra studs above where you placed it
local STRENGTH = 15 -- how fast it gets back home (Responsiveness)
local KEEP_UPRIGHT = true -- stop it tipping over?

local part = script.Parent
part.Anchored = false
local home = part.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, HOVER_HEIGHT, 0)

local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
attachment.Parent = part

-- AlignPosition pulls the part toward a spot (OneAttachment means "toward a position")
local align = Instance.new("AlignPosition")
align.Mode = Enum.PositionAlignmentMode.OneAttachment
align.Attachment0 = attachment
align.Position = home.Position
align.Responsiveness = STRENGTH
align.MaxForce = part.AssemblyMass * workspace.Gravity * 5
align.Parent = part

if KEEP_UPRIGHT then
	local orient = Instance.new("AlignOrientation")
	orient.Mode = Enum.OrientationAlignmentMode.OneAttachment
	orient.Attachment0 = attachment
	orient.CFrame = home.Rotation
	orient.Responsiveness = STRENGTH
	orient.Parent = part
end

part:SetNetworkOwner(nil)

scripts.title: Move along a path of waypoints
scripts.where: Put this Script inside an Anchored Part, then make a Folder named Waypoints next to it with Parts named 1, 2, 3 and so on.
scripts.about: Moves the part smoothly from waypoint 1 to 2 to 3 and back to the start, at the same speed the whole way.
scripts.code:
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local SPEED = 12 -- studs per second
local PAUSE = 0.5 -- seconds to wait at each waypoint
local FACE_DIRECTION = true -- turn to face where it is going?

local part = script.Parent
part.Anchored = true
local folder = part.Parent:WaitForChild("Waypoints")

-- Put the waypoints in number order
local points = {}
for _, p in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
	if p:IsA("BasePart") and tonumber(p.Name) then
		table.insert(points, p)
		p.Transparency = 1
		p.CanCollide = false
	end
end
table.sort(points, function(a, b)
	return tonumber(a.Name) < tonumber(b.Name)
end)
if #points < 2 then
	warn("Add at least 2 waypoints named 1 and 2")
	return
end

local index = 1
while true do
	local target = points[index]
	local distance = (target.Position - part.Position).Magnitude
	local goal = CFrame.new(target.Position) * part.CFrame.Rotation
	if FACE_DIRECTION and distance > 0.1 then
		goal = CFrame.lookAt(target.Position, target.Position + (target.Position - part.Position).Unit)
	end
	-- Time = distance / speed, so long gaps take longer and the speed stays the same
	local tween = TweenService:Create(part, TweenInfo.new(distance / SPEED, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), { CFrame = goal })
	tween:Play()
	tween.Completed:Wait()
	task.wait(PAUSE)
	index = index % #points + 1
end

scripts.title: Moving platform
scripts.where: Put this Script inside the Part you want to slide back and forth (it will be Anchored for you).
keywords: part that goes back and forth
scripts.about: Slides the part back and forth forever, and players standing on it ride along.
scripts.code:
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local MOVE_BY = Vector3.new(0, 0, 20) -- how far it moves (X, Y, Z in studs)
local TIME = 3 -- seconds to move one way (smaller = faster)

local part = script.Parent
part.Anchored = true
local startPosition = part.Position

-- Slide to the end, then back again, forever (-1 = repeat forever, true = go back)
local info = TweenInfo.new(TIME, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, true)
local tween = TweenService:Create(part, info, { Position = startPosition + MOVE_BY })
tween:Play()

-- This tells physics how fast the part moves, so players on top ride along
local lastPosition = part.Position
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	local nowPosition = part.Position
	if dt > 0 then
		part.AssemblyLinearVelocity = (nowPosition - lastPosition) / dt
	end
	lastPosition = nowPosition
end)

scripts.title: Parking gate barrier
scripts.where: Put this Script inside the Anchored barrier arm Part (long along X, with the hinge at the -X end).
scripts.about: Press E to lift the barrier arm; it stays up for a few seconds and then comes back down.
scripts.code:
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local OPEN_ANGLE = 85 -- degrees it lifts
local STAY_OPEN = 4 -- seconds before it closes

local arm = script.Parent
arm.Anchored = true
local closed = arm.CFrame
-- Spin around the end of the arm, not the middle
local pivot = closed * CFrame.new(-arm.Size.X / 2, 0, 0)
local open = pivot * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(OPEN_ANGLE)) * CFrame.new(arm.Size.X / 2, 0, 0)

local openTween = TweenService:Create(arm, TweenInfo.new(0.8, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), { CFrame = open })
local closeTween = TweenService:Create(arm, TweenInfo.new(0.8, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), { CFrame = closed })

local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
prompt.ActionText = "Open gate"
prompt.ObjectText = "Barrier"
prompt.Parent = arm

prompt.Triggered:Connect(function()
	prompt.Enabled = false
	openTween:Play()
	openTween.Completed:Wait()
	task.wait(STAY_OPEN)
	closeTween:Play()
	closeTween.Completed:Wait()
	prompt.Enabled = true
end)

scripts.title: Part that grows and shrinks
scripts.where: Put this Script inside an Anchored Part.
scripts.about: Makes the part smoothly grow bigger and shrink back forever, like it is breathing.
scripts.code:
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local GROW_AMOUNT = 1.5 -- 1.5 = grows to one and a half times as big
local PULSE_TIME = 1 -- seconds to grow once
local GLOW = true -- also get brighter when big?

local part = script.Parent
part.Anchored = true
local goal = { Size = part.Size * GROW_AMOUNT }
if GLOW then
	goal.Transparency = math.max(part.Transparency - 0.3, 0)
	part.Transparency = math.min(part.Transparency + 0.3, 0.9)
end

-- RepeatCount -1 = forever, Reverses true = shrink back after growing
local info = TweenInfo.new(PULSE_TIME, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, true)
TweenService:Create(part, info, goal):Play()

scripts.title: Part that hops to random spots
scripts.where: Put this Script inside an Anchored Part, and make a Folder named HopSpots in Workspace with invisible Parts marking where it can appear.
scripts.about: Every few seconds the part fades out and pops up at a different random spot.
scripts.code:
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local STAY_TIME = 3 -- seconds it stays in one spot
local FADE_TIME = 0.3

local part = script.Parent
part.Anchored = true
local spots = workspace:WaitForChild("HopSpots")
local normalTransparency = part.Transparency
local lastSpot

local fadeOut = TweenService:Create(part, TweenInfo.new(FADE_TIME), { Transparency = 1 })
local fadeIn = TweenService:Create(part, TweenInfo.new(FADE_TIME), { Transparency = normalTransparency })

while true do
	task.wait(STAY_TIME)
	local choices = {}
	for _, spot in ipairs(spots:GetChildren()) do
		if spot:IsA("BasePart") and spot ~= lastSpot then
			table.insert(choices, spot)
		end
	end
	if #choices > 0 then
		local spot = choices[math.random(#choices)]
		lastSpot = spot
		fadeOut:Play()
		fadeOut.Completed:Wait()
		part.CFrame = spot.CFrame
		fadeIn:Play()
	end
end

scripts.title: Part that orbits around another
scripts.where: Put this Script inside an Anchored Part, and set the CENTER_NAME below to the name of a part in Workspace it should circle around.
scripts.about: Moves the part round and round in a circle around a center part, like a moon around a planet.
scripts.code:
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

-- Settings: change these!
local CENTER_NAME = "Planet" -- the part in Workspace to circle around
local RADIUS = 20 -- how far away it orbits
local SECONDS_PER_LAP = 8
local FACE_CENTER = true -- keep facing the middle?

local part = script.Parent
part.Anchored = true
local center = workspace:WaitForChild(CENTER_NAME)
local height = part.Position.Y - center.Position.Y -- keep the height it started at

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	local angle = (os.clock() / SECONDS_PER_LAP) * math.pi * 2
	-- cos and sin give a point on a circle
	local offset = Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * RADIUS, height, math.sin(angle) * RADIUS)
	local position = center.Position + offset
	if FACE_CENTER then
		part.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(position, center.Position)
	else
		part.CFrame = CFrame.new(position) * part.CFrame.Rotation
	end
end)

scripts.title: Part that watches the nearest player
scripts.where: Put this Script inside an Anchored Part (like an eyeball, statue head or camera) whose front face should look at players.
scripts.about: Turns the part every frame so its front face looks at the closest player.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local RANGE = 60 -- only watch players closer than this
local TURN_SPEED = 8 -- bigger = snaps faster, smaller = turns lazily

local part = script.Parent
part.Anchored = true
local restCFrame = part.CFrame

local function nearestRoot()
	local best, bestDistance = nil, RANGE
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local root = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if root then
			local distance = (root.Position - part.Position).Magnitude
			if distance < bestDistance then
				best, bestDistance = root, distance
			end
		end
	end
	return best
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
	local target = nearestRoot()
	local goal = restCFrame
	if target then
		goal = CFrame.lookAt(part.Position, target.Position)
	end
	-- Lerp turns a little bit toward the goal each frame, so it looks smooth
	part.CFrame = part.CFrame:Lerp(goal, math.clamp(TURN_SPEED * deltaTime, 0, 1))
end)

scripts.title: Piston that pushes players
scripts.where: Put this Script inside an Anchored Part placed beside the path, with its front face pointing at the path.
scripts.about: The piston shoots out, shoves any player it hits off the path, then pulls back in.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local PUSH_DISTANCE = 8 -- how far it shoots out
local PUSH_FORCE = 80 -- how hard players fly
local WAIT_TIME = 2 -- seconds between pushes

local piston = script.Parent
piston.Anchored = true
local inCFrame = piston.CFrame
local outCFrame = inCFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -PUSH_DISTANCE) -- "forward" is minus Z

local shootOut = TweenService:Create(piston, TweenInfo.new(0.15), { CFrame = outCFrame })
local pullIn = TweenService:Create(piston, TweenInfo.new(1), { CFrame = inCFrame })
local pushing = false
local pushed = {}

piston.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	if not pushing then
		return
	end
	local character = hit.Parent
	local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if player and root and not pushed[player] then
		pushed[player] = true
		root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = inCFrame.LookVector * PUSH_FORCE + Vector3.new(0, 20, 0)
	end
end)

while true do
	task.wait(WAIT_TIME)
	table.clear(pushed)
	pushing = true
	shootOut:Play()
	shootOut.Completed:Wait()
	pushing = false
	pullIn:Play()
	pullIn.Completed:Wait()
end

scripts.title: Shaking part
scripts.where: Put this Script inside an Anchored Part (or the PrimaryPart of a Model) that should rattle.
scripts.about: Makes the part rattle and shake in place, great for engines, washing machines or scary things.
scripts.code:
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local SHAKE_AMOUNT = 0.15 -- studs it moves each way
local TILT_AMOUNT = 2 -- degrees it tilts
local ONLY_SOMETIMES = false -- true = shake for 1 second every few seconds

local part = script.Parent
part.Anchored = true
local home = part.CFrame
local shaking = true

local function random(amount)
	return (math.random() * 2 - 1) * amount
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	if not shaking then
		part.CFrame = home
		return
	end
	part.CFrame = home
		* CFrame.new(random(SHAKE_AMOUNT), random(SHAKE_AMOUNT), random(SHAKE_AMOUNT))
		* CFrame.Angles(math.rad(random(TILT_AMOUNT)), 0, math.rad(random(TILT_AMOUNT)))
end)

if ONLY_SOMETIMES then
	while true do
		shaking = false
		task.wait(math.random(3, 6))
		shaking = true
		task.wait(1)
	end
end

scripts.title: Spinning disk you can ride
scripts.where: Put this Script inside a Cylinder Part lying flat (the disk); it does not need to be Anchored.
scripts.about: The disk spins with a physics motor, so players standing on it get carried around.
scripts.code:
-- Settings: change these numbers!
local SPEED = 1 -- radians per second (bigger = faster)

local disk = script.Parent

-- An invisible anchored part under the middle works as the axle
local axle = Instance.new("Part")
axle.Name = "DiskAxle"
axle.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
axle.Transparency = 1
axle.CanCollide = false
axle.Anchored = true
axle.CFrame = disk.CFrame
axle.Parent = disk.Parent

-- Point both attachments straight up, so the hinge spins around the up axis
local upwards = CFrame.fromMatrix(Vector3.zero, Vector3.yAxis, Vector3.xAxis)
local a0 = Instance.new("Attachment")
a0.Parent = axle
a0.WorldCFrame = CFrame.new(disk.Position) * upwards
local a1 = Instance.new("Attachment")
a1.Parent = disk
a1.WorldCFrame = a0.WorldCFrame

local motor = Instance.new("HingeConstraint")
motor.Attachment0 = a0
motor.Attachment1 = a1
motor.ActuatorType = Enum.ActuatorType.Motor
motor.AngularVelocity = SPEED
motor.MotorMaxTorque = 1e9
motor.Parent = disk

disk.Anchored = false
disk:SetNetworkOwner(nil)

scripts.title: Spinning part
scripts.where: Put this Script inside the Part you want to spin (it will be Anchored for you).
scripts.about: Spins the part around and around, and pushes players it hits.
scripts.code:
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local SPEED = 90 -- degrees per second (bigger = faster, negative = other way)
local AXIS = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) -- spin around: (0,1,0) = flat like a fan, (1,0,0) = like a wheel

local part = script.Parent
part.Anchored = true

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	-- Turn a tiny bit every frame
	part.CFrame = part.CFrame * CFrame.fromAxisAngle(AXIS, math.rad(SPEED) * dt)
	-- Tell physics it's spinning, so it pushes players instead of sliding under them
	part.AssemblyAngularVelocity = part.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(AXIS) * math.rad(SPEED)
end)

scripts.title: Stairs that rise from the floor
scripts.where: Put this Script inside a Model that has a Part named Button and a Folder named Steps holding Anchored step Parts named 1, 2, 3 and so on (build them where they should end up).
keywords: steps come out of the floor
scripts.about: Touching the button makes hidden stairs rise out of the floor one step at a time, then sink back later.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local HIDE_DEPTH = 12 -- how far below the floor the steps hide
local STEP_DELAY = 0.15 -- seconds between each step rising
local STAY_TIME = 10 -- seconds before the stairs sink again

local model = script.Parent
local button = model:WaitForChild("Button")
local steps = {}
for _, step in ipairs(model:WaitForChild("Steps"):GetChildren()) do
	if step:IsA("BasePart") and tonumber(step.Name) then
		table.insert(steps, { part = step, up = step.CFrame })
		step.Anchored = true
		step.CFrame = step.CFrame - Vector3.new(0, HIDE_DEPTH, 0)
	end
end
table.sort(steps, function(a, b)
	return tonumber(a.part.Name) < tonumber(b.part.Name)
end)

local function moveAll(goingUp)
	for _, step in ipairs(steps) do
		local goal = goingUp and step.up or step.up - Vector3.new(0, HIDE_DEPTH, 0)
		TweenService:Create(step.part, TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Back), { CFrame = goal }):Play()
		task.wait(STEP_DELAY)
	end
end

local busy = false
button.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	if busy or not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent) then
		return
	end
	busy = true
	button.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 0)
	moveAll(true)
	task.wait(STAY_TIME)
	moveAll(false)
	button.Color = Color3.fromRGB(200, 0, 0)
	busy = false
end)

scripts.title: Tween a whole model (module)
scripts.where: Put this ModuleScript in ReplicatedStorage and name it ModelTween, then require it from any Script.
scripts.about: Lets you smoothly move or turn a whole Model with TweenService, which normally only works on single parts.
scripts.code:
--[[ How to use it from a Script:
	local ModelTween = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.ModelTween)
	local door = workspace.BigDoor -- any Model
	local goal = door:GetPivot() * CFrame.new(0, 10, 0) -- 10 studs up
	ModelTween.tween(door, goal, TweenInfo.new(2)):Completed:Wait()
]]

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local ModelTween = {}

-- Moves `model` to `goalCFrame` using `tweenInfo`. Returns the Tween so you can wait for it.
function ModelTween.tween(model, goalCFrame, tweenInfo)
	-- Trick: tween a CFrameValue, and every time it changes, move the model there with PivotTo
	local value = Instance.new("CFrameValue")
	value.Value = model:GetPivot()

	local connection = value.Changed:Connect(function(newCFrame)
		model:PivotTo(newCFrame)
	end)

	local tween = TweenService:Create(value, tweenInfo, { Value = goalCFrame })
	tween.Completed:Once(function()
		connection:Disconnect()
		value:Destroy()
	end)
	tween:Play()
	return tween
end

-- Handy extra: move the model by an offset, like ModelTween.moveBy(model, Vector3.new(0, 5, 0), 1)
function ModelTween.moveBy(model, offset, seconds)
	return ModelTween.tween(model, model:GetPivot() + offset, TweenInfo.new(seconds or 1, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad))
end

return ModelTween

scripts.title: Tween sequence (module)
scripts.where: Put this ModuleScript in ReplicatedStorage and name it TweenSequence, then require it from any Script.
scripts.about: Plays a list of tweens on a part one after another, and can loop them, so you can make little animations easily.
scripts.code:
--[[ How to use it from a Script inside a Part:
	local TweenSequence = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.TweenSequence)
	local part = script.Parent
	TweenSequence.play(part, {
		{ time = 1, goal = { Position = part.Position + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0) } },
		{ time = 0.5, goal = { Color = Color3.new(1, 0, 0) }, waitAfter = 1 },
		{ time = 1, goal = { Position = part.Position, Color = part.Color } },
	}, true) -- true = loop forever
]]

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local TweenSequence = {}

-- steps: a list of { time = seconds, goal = {Property = value}, style = Enum.EasingStyle (optional), waitAfter = seconds (optional) }
-- loop: true to repeat forever. Returns a function you can call to stop it.
function TweenSequence.play(instance, steps, loop)
	local running = true
	local current

	task.spawn(function()
		repeat
			for _, step in ipairs(steps) do
				if not running or not instance.Parent then
					return
				end
				local info = TweenInfo.new(step.time or 1, step.style or Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
				current = TweenService:Create(instance, info, step.goal)
				current:Play()
				current.Completed:Wait()
				if step.waitAfter then
					task.wait(step.waitAfter)
				end
			end
		until not loop or not running
	end)

	return function()
		running = false
		if current then
			current:Cancel()
		end
	end
end

return TweenSequence

scripts.title: Wrecking ball
scripts.where: Put this Script inside an unanchored Ball Part, and put an Anchored Part named BallPivot above it where the chain hangs from.
scripts.about: The heavy ball swings on a chain forever and sends players flying if it hits them.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local PUSH_EVERY = 2.5 -- seconds between pushes that keep it swinging
local PUSH_POWER = 30 -- how hard each push is
local KNOCK_POWER = 100 -- how far players fly

local ball = script.Parent
local pivot = ball.Parent:WaitForChild("BallPivot")
pivot.Anchored = true
ball.Anchored = false

-- A rod keeps the ball the same distance from the pivot (like a stiff chain)
local a0 = Instance.new("Attachment")
a0.Parent = pivot
local a1 = Instance.new("Attachment")
a1.Parent = ball
local rod = Instance.new("RodConstraint")
rod.Attachment0 = a0
rod.Attachment1 = a1
rod.Length = (pivot.Position - ball.Position).Magnitude
rod.Visible = true
rod.Thickness = 0.4
rod.Parent = ball

ball:SetNetworkOwner(nil)

local recent = {}
ball.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	local character = hit.Parent
	local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if player and root and not recent[player] and ball.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude > 10 then
		recent[player] = true
		root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = ball.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Unit * KNOCK_POWER + Vector3.new(0, 30, 0)
		task.delay(1, function()
			recent[player] = nil
		end)
	end
end)

-- Keep it swinging: push the way it is already moving
local direction = pivot.CFrame.LookVector
while true do
	local velocity = ball.AssemblyLinearVelocity
	local flat = Vector3.new(velocity.X, 0, velocity.Z)
	if flat.Magnitude > 1 then
		direction = flat.Unit
	end
	ball:ApplyImpulse(direction * ball.AssemblyMass * PUSH_POWER)
	task.wait(PUSH_EVERY)
end

scripts.title: Zipline
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts, then make a Model in Workspace with two Parts named ZipStart and ZipEnd, and put a ProximityPrompt named Zipline inside ZipStart.
scripts.about: Press E at the start of a zipline to zoom along the cable to the end.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ProximityPromptService = game:GetService("ProximityPromptService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local SPEED = 50 -- studs per second
local HANG_BELOW = 3.5 -- how far below the cable your body hangs

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local riding = false

ProximityPromptService.PromptTriggered:Connect(function(prompt)
	-- Only zipline prompts, and only one ride at a time
	if prompt.Name ~= "Zipline" or riding then
		return
	end
	local startPart = prompt.Parent
	local endPart = startPart.Parent:FindFirstChild("ZipEnd")
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not endPart or not humanoid or not root then
		return
	end

	riding = true
	humanoid.PlatformStand = true -- stop walking while hanging on
	local from = startPart.Position - Vector3.new(0, HANG_BELOW, 0)
	local to = endPart.Position - Vector3.new(0, HANG_BELOW, 0)
	local direction = (to - from).Unit
	local travelTime = (to - from).Magnitude / SPEED
	local started = os.clock()

	local connection
	connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local alpha = math.min((os.clock() - started) / travelTime, 1)
		-- Slide along the line and face the way we are going
		root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(from:Lerp(to, alpha), from:Lerp(to, alpha) + Vector3.new(direction.X, 0, direction.Z))
		root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = direction * SPEED
		if alpha >= 1 or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
			connection:Disconnect()
			humanoid.PlatformStand = false
			root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = direction * 20 -- a little hop off the end
			riding = false
		end
	end)
end)

scripts.title: Bomb platform with countdown
scripts.where: Put this Script inside an Anchored Part that players stand on.
scripts.about: Stepping on the platform starts a 3 2 1 countdown, then it explodes and comes back later.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local COUNTDOWN = 3 -- seconds before it explodes
local RESPAWN_TIME = 4 -- seconds before it comes back
local DAMAGE = 60

local platform = script.Parent
local active = false

-- Floating number above the platform
local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
billboard.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(80, 80)
billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)
billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
billboard.Parent = platform
local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
label.TextScaled = true
label.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 60)
label.Text = ""
label.Parent = billboard

platform.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	if active or not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent) then
		return
	end
	active = true
	for i = COUNTDOWN, 1, -1 do
		label.Text = tostring(i)
		task.wait(1)
	end
	label.Text = ""

	-- BOOM! DestroyJointRadiusPercent = 0 means it only hurts, it does not insta-kill
	local explosion = Instance.new("Explosion")
	explosion.Position = platform.Position
	explosion.BlastRadius = math.max(platform.Size.X, platform.Size.Z)
	explosion.DestroyJointRadiusPercent = 0
	local hurt = {}
	explosion.Hit:Connect(function(part)
		local humanoid = part.Parent and part.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if humanoid and not hurt[humanoid] then
			hurt[humanoid] = true
			humanoid:TakeDamage(DAMAGE)
		end
	end)
	explosion.Parent = workspace

	-- Disappear, then come back
	platform.Transparency = 1
	platform.CanCollide = false
	task.wait(RESPAWN_TIME)
	platform.Transparency = 0
	platform.CanCollide = true
	active = false
end)

scripts.title: Bouncy wall
scripts.where: Put this Script inside an Anchored wall Part.
scripts.about: Players who touch the wall get bounced away from it with a springy boing.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local PUSH = 70 -- how hard you get pushed away
local UP = 30 -- a little upward bounce
local COOLDOWN = 0.5

local wall = script.Parent
local recent = {}

wall.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	local character = hit.Parent
	local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not player or not root or recent[player] then
		return
	end
	recent[player] = true

	-- Direction from the wall toward the player (flat, no up or down)
	local away = root.Position - wall.Position
	away = Vector3.new(away.X, 0, away.Z)
	if away.Magnitude < 0.1 then
		away = wall.CFrame.LookVector
	end
	root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = away.Unit * PUSH + Vector3.new(0, UP, 0)

	-- Squish the wall a tiny bit for fun
	local size = wall.Size
	wall.Size = size * 0.95
	task.delay(0.1, function()
		wall.Size = size
	end)

	task.delay(COOLDOWN, function()
		recent[player] = nil
	end)
end)

scripts.title: Cannon that fires balls
scripts.where: Put this Script inside an Anchored Part (the cannon) and turn the part so its front face points where it should shoot.
scripts.about: Shoots a cannonball out of its front face every few seconds that knocks players over and hurts them.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local FIRE_EVERY = 2 -- seconds between shots
local BALL_SPEED = 80 -- how fast the ball flies
local BALL_SIZE = 3
local DAMAGE = 30
local BALL_LIFETIME = 5 -- seconds before the ball disappears

local cannon = script.Parent

local function fire()
	local ball = Instance.new("Part")
	ball.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
	ball.Size = Vector3.new(BALL_SIZE, BALL_SIZE, BALL_SIZE)
	ball.Color = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
	ball.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
	-- Start just in front of the cannon
	ball.CFrame = cannon.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -(cannon.Size.Z / 2 + BALL_SIZE))
	ball.Parent = workspace
	ball:SetNetworkOwner(nil) -- the server moves it, so it flies smoothly
	ball.AssemblyLinearVelocity = cannon.CFrame.LookVector * BALL_SPEED

	local hitPlayers = {}
	ball.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
		local character = hit.Parent
		local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if player and humanoid and not hitPlayers[player] then
			hitPlayers[player] = true
			humanoid:TakeDamage(DAMAGE)
		end
	end)
	Debris:AddItem(ball, BALL_LIFETIME) -- clean up automatically
end

while true do
	fire()
	task.wait(FIRE_EVERY)
end

scripts.title: Checkpoints
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService, then make a Folder named Checkpoints in Workspace with SpawnLocations inside named 1, 2, 3 and so on (1 is the start).
scripts.about: Touching a checkpoint makes it the place where you come back to life.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local checkpoints = workspace:WaitForChild("Checkpoints")
local best = {} -- the highest checkpoint each player reached

-- Get ready a checkpoint so touching it saves your spot
local function setupCheckpoint(checkpoint)
	if not checkpoint:IsA("SpawnLocation") then
		return
	end
	checkpoint.Neutral = true -- everyone can use it, any team

	checkpoint.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
		local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
		local number = tonumber(checkpoint.Name)
		if not player or not number then
			return
		end
		-- Only save if it's further than before (no going back!)
		if number > (best[player] or 0) then
			best[player] = number
			player.RespawnLocation = checkpoint
		end
	end)
end

for _, checkpoint in ipairs(checkpoints:GetChildren()) do
	setupCheckpoint(checkpoint)
end
checkpoints.ChildAdded:Connect(setupCheckpoint)

-- New players start at checkpoint 1
local function onPlayerAdded(player)
	local first = checkpoints:FindFirstChild("1")
	if first and first:IsA("SpawnLocation") then
		best[player] = 1
		player.RespawnLocation = first
	end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
	onPlayerAdded(player)
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	best[player] = nil
end)

scripts.title: Crumbling bridge
scripts.where: Put this Script inside a Model or Folder that holds all the Anchored plank Parts of your bridge.
scripts.about: Each plank turns red and falls a moment after someone steps on it, then grows back later.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local FALL_DELAY = 0.5 -- seconds after touching before the plank drops
local RESPAWN_TIME = 5 -- seconds before the plank comes back
local WARNING_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(200, 60, 40)

local function setupPlank(plank)
	local home = plank.CFrame
	local normalColor = plank.Color
	local falling = false

	plank.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
		if falling or not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent) then
			return
		end
		falling = true
		plank.Color = WARNING_COLOR
		task.wait(FALL_DELAY)

		-- Let gravity take it
		plank.Anchored = false
		plank.CanCollide = false
		task.wait(RESPAWN_TIME)

		-- Grow back
		plank.Anchored = true
		plank.CFrame = home
		plank.Color = normalColor
		plank.CanCollide = true
		falling = false
	end)
end

for _, child in ipairs(script.Parent:GetChildren()) do
	if child:IsA("BasePart") then
		setupPlank(child)
	end
end

scripts.title: Crusher that slams down
scripts.where: Put this Script inside an Anchored Part placed in the air above the path (the crusher block).
scripts.about: The block slams down fast, crushing anyone under it, then slowly rises back up.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local DROP_DISTANCE = 10 -- how far down it slams (studs)
local WAIT_UP = 2 -- seconds it waits at the top
local WAIT_DOWN = 0.5 -- seconds it stays down

local crusher = script.Parent
crusher.Anchored = true
local top = crusher.CFrame
local bottom = top * CFrame.new(0, -DROP_DISTANCE, 0)

local slam = TweenService:Create(crusher, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), { CFrame = bottom })
local rise = TweenService:Create(crusher, TweenInfo.new(1.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine), { CFrame = top })

local slamming = false
crusher.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	if not slamming then
		return -- it is only deadly while falling
	end
	local character = hit.Parent
	if Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character) then
		local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if humanoid then
			humanoid.Health = 0
		end
	end
end)

while true do
	task.wait(WAIT_UP)
	slamming = true
	slam:Play()
	slam.Completed:Wait()
	slamming = false
	task.wait(WAIT_DOWN)
	rise:Play()
	rise.Completed:Wait()
end

scripts.title: Damage zone
scripts.where: Put this Script inside a Part that covers the hurting area (turn off CanCollide and make it see-through if you like).
scripts.about: Players standing inside the zone keep losing health a little at a time.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local DAMAGE = 10 -- health lost each tick
local TICK_TIME = 1 -- seconds between ticks

local zone = script.Parent

-- Only look at things that are not the zone itself
local params = OverlapParams.new()
params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { zone }

while true do
	task.wait(TICK_TIME)

	-- Find every player character inside the zone (each one only once)
	local hurt = {}
	for _, hit in ipairs(workspace:GetPartsInPart(zone, params)) do
		local character = hit.Parent
		local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
		if player and not hurt[player] then
			hurt[player] = true
			local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
				humanoid:TakeDamage(DAMAGE)
			end
		end
	end
end

scripts.title: Disappearing platform
scripts.where: Put this Script inside the platform Part that should fade away when someone steps on it.
scripts.about: The platform fades away after someone steps on it, then comes back.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local WAIT_BEFORE_FADE = 0.5 -- seconds before it starts fading
local FADE_TIME = 1 -- seconds it takes to fade out
local COME_BACK_TIME = 3 -- seconds before it comes back

local part = script.Parent
local startTransparency = part.Transparency
local busy = false

local function fadeTo(transparency)
	local tween = TweenService:Create(part, TweenInfo.new(FADE_TIME), { Transparency = transparency })
	tween:Play()
	tween.Completed:Wait()
end

part.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	-- Only players start the fade, and only once at a time
	if busy or not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent) then
		return
	end
	busy = true

	task.wait(WAIT_BEFORE_FADE)
	fadeTo(1)
	part.CanCollide = false -- now you fall through!

	task.wait(COME_BACK_TIME)
	part.CanCollide = true
	fadeTo(startTransparency)
	busy = false
end)

scripts.title: Electric floor
scripts.where: Put this Script inside an Anchored floor Part.
scripts.about: The floor flashes yellow as a warning, then turns electric blue and shocks anyone standing on it.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local SAFE_TIME = 3
local WARNING_TIME = 1.5
local SHOCK_TIME = 2
local DAMAGE_PER_TICK = 15 -- damage every 0.2 seconds while shocking

local floor = script.Parent
local safeColor = floor.Color
local safeMaterial = floor.Material

-- Find humanoids standing on top of the floor (in a thin box just above it)
local function humanoidsOnTop()
	local found = {}
	local boxCFrame = floor.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, floor.Size.Y / 2 + 1.5, 0)
	local boxSize = Vector3.new(floor.Size.X, 3, floor.Size.Z)
	for _, part in ipairs(workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(boxCFrame, boxSize)) do
		local humanoid = part.Parent and part.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if humanoid and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(humanoid.Parent) then
			found[humanoid] = true
		end
	end
	return found
end

while true do
	-- Safe
	floor.Color = safeColor
	floor.Material = safeMaterial
	task.wait(SAFE_TIME)

	-- Warning: blink yellow
	for _ = 1, math.floor(WARNING_TIME / 0.25) do
		floor.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 0)
		task.wait(0.125)
		floor.Color = safeColor
		task.wait(0.125)
	end

	-- Shock!
	floor.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255)
	floor.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	local shockEnd = os.clock() + SHOCK_TIME
	while os.clock() < shockEnd do
		for humanoid in pairs(humanoidsOnTop()) do
			humanoid:TakeDamage(DAMAGE_PER_TICK)
		end
		task.wait(0.2)
	end
end

scripts.title: Fall kill height
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService.
scripts.about: Anyone who falls below a set height gets reset.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local KILL_HEIGHT = -50 -- fall lower than this Y position and you reset
local CHECK_EVERY = 0.25 -- seconds between checks

while true do
	task.wait(CHECK_EVERY)

	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local character = player.Character
		local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

		-- Too low? Reset them!
		if root and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and root.Position.Y < KILL_HEIGHT then
			humanoid.Health = 0
		end
	end
end

scripts.title: Falling block trap
scripts.where: Put this Script inside an Anchored Part that players walk on.
scripts.about: When a player steps on the block it shakes, falls down, then comes back a few seconds later.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local SHAKE_TIME = 0.6 -- seconds of shaking before it drops
local COME_BACK_TIME = 4 -- seconds before it comes back

local block = script.Parent
local homeCFrame = block.CFrame -- remember where it started
local busy = false

block.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	if busy or not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent) then
		return
	end
	busy = true

	-- Shake a little so players know it is going to fall
	local shakeEnd = os.clock() + SHAKE_TIME
	while os.clock() < shakeEnd do
		local wiggle = Vector3.new(math.random(-10, 10), 0, math.random(-10, 10)) / 100
		block.CFrame = homeCFrame + wiggle
		task.wait(0.05)
	end

	-- Drop it! (unanchored parts fall because of gravity)
	block.CFrame = homeCFrame
	block.Anchored = false
	block.CanCollide = false
	task.wait(COME_BACK_TIME)

	-- Put it back home
	block.Anchored = true
	block.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
	block.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
	block.CFrame = homeCFrame
	block.CanCollide = true
	busy = false
end)

scripts.title: Falling icicles
scripts.where: Put this Script inside an Anchored icicle Part hanging from a ceiling.
scripts.about: When a player walks underneath, the icicle shakes, falls and hurts them, then grows back.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local SEE_DISTANCE = 40 -- how far down it looks for players
local DAMAGE = 40
local REGROW_TIME = 5

local icicle = script.Parent
icicle.Anchored = true
local home = icicle.CFrame
local falling = false
local hurt = {}

local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { icicle }

icicle.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	local character = hit.Parent
	local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if falling and player and humanoid and not hurt[player] then
		hurt[player] = true
		humanoid:TakeDamage(DAMAGE)
	end
end)

while true do
	task.wait(0.2)
	-- Shoot an invisible ray straight down to see what is under the icicle
	local result = workspace:Raycast(icicle.Position, Vector3.new(0, -SEE_DISTANCE, 0), rayParams)
	local hitModel = result and result.Instance:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
	if hitModel and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hitModel) then
		-- Shake as a warning
		for _ = 1, 6 do
			icicle.CFrame = home * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(math.random(-4, 4)))
			task.wait(0.05)
		end
		icicle.CFrame = home
		falling = true
		table.clear(hurt)
		icicle.Anchored = false
		task.wait(REGROW_TIME)
		falling = false
		icicle.Anchored = true
		icicle.CFrame = home
	end
end

scripts.title: Glass bridge (pick the right panel)
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService, then make a Folder named GlassBridge in Workspace with one Folder per row, each holding two Anchored glass Parts side by side.
scripts.about: In every row one glass panel is real and one is fake and shatters when you step on it.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local RESHUFFLE_EVERY = 60 -- seconds before the safe panels are picked again
local BROKEN_TIME = 3 -- seconds a broken panel stays gone

local bridge = workspace:WaitForChild("GlassBridge")
local fake = {} -- part -> true if it is a fake panel

local function shuffle()
	table.clear(fake)
	for _, row in ipairs(bridge:GetChildren()) do
		local panels = {}
		for _, part in ipairs(row:GetChildren()) do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then
				table.insert(panels, part)
			end
		end
		if #panels >= 2 then
			-- Pick one panel at random to be the safe one, the rest are fake
			local safeIndex = math.random(1, #panels)
			for i, panel in ipairs(panels) do
				fake[panel] = i ~= safeIndex
			end
		end
	end
end

local function setupPanel(panel)
	panel.Material = Enum.Material.Glass
	panel.Transparency = 0.4
	panel.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
		if not fake[panel] or not panel.CanCollide then
			return
		end
		if not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent) then
			return
		end
		-- Shatter!
		panel.CanCollide = false
		panel.Transparency = 1
		task.wait(BROKEN_TIME)
		panel.CanCollide = true
		panel.Transparency = 0.4
	end)
end

for _, part in ipairs(bridge:GetDescendants()) do
	if part:IsA("BasePart") then
		setupPanel(part)
	end
end

while true do
	shuffle()
	task.wait(RESHUFFLE_EVERY)
end

scripts.title: Invisible path that appears
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts, then make a Folder named HiddenPath in Workspace and put your path parts inside.
scripts.about: Path parts are invisible until you walk close, then they fade in just for you.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local SHOW_DISTANCE = 12 -- studs: parts closer than this are fully visible
local FADE_DISTANCE = 20 -- studs: parts start fading in from here

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local folder = workspace:WaitForChild("HiddenPath")

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	local character = player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	for _, part in ipairs(folder:GetDescendants()) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then
			if not root then
				part.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
			else
				local distance = (part.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
				-- 0 = fully visible, 1 = invisible, with a smooth fade in between
				local fade = math.clamp((distance - SHOW_DISTANCE) / (FADE_DISTANCE - SHOW_DISTANCE), 0, 1)
				part.LocalTransparencyModifier = fade
			end
		end
	end
end)

scripts.title: Laser that turns on and off
scripts.where: Put this Script inside a thin Anchored Part that is your laser beam (Neon material looks best).
keywords: laser that turns on and off
scripts.about: The laser blinks on and off, and touching it while it is on resets you.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local ON_TIME = 2 -- seconds the laser is dangerous
local OFF_TIME = 2 -- seconds the laser is safe
local LASER_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(255, 40, 40)

local laser = script.Parent
laser.Anchored = true
laser.CanCollide = false -- you walk through it (and get zapped!)
laser.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
laser.Color = LASER_COLOR

-- Touching the laser only works while CanTouch is true (when it is on)
laser.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	local character = hit.Parent
	if not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character) then
		return
	end
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if humanoid then
		humanoid.Health = 0
	end
end)

-- Blink forever
while true do
	-- ON: you can see it and it hurts
	laser.Transparency = 0.2
	laser.CanTouch = true
	task.wait(ON_TIME)

	-- OFF: invisible and safe
	laser.Transparency = 1
	laser.CanTouch = false
	task.wait(OFF_TIME)
end

scripts.title: Low gravity zone
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterCharacterScripts, then make a Folder named LowGravityZones in Workspace with invisible, non-colliding Parts inside.
scripts.about: Inside a low gravity zone players float down slowly and jump much higher, like on the moon.
scripts.code:
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

-- Settings: change this number!
local GRAVITY_SCALE = 0.25 -- 0.25 = a quarter of normal gravity, 0 = no gravity at all

local character = script.Parent
local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local zones = workspace:WaitForChild("LowGravityZones")

local function isInside(part, point)
	local localPoint = part.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(point)
	local half = part.Size / 2
	return math.abs(localPoint.X) <= half.X and math.abs(localPoint.Y) <= half.Y and math.abs(localPoint.Z) <= half.Z
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
	for _, zone in ipairs(zones:GetChildren()) do
		if zone:IsA("BasePart") and isInside(zone, root.Position) then
			-- Push up a little to cancel part of the gravity pulling us down
			local lift = workspace.Gravity * (1 - GRAVITY_SCALE) * deltaTime
			root.AssemblyLinearVelocity += Vector3.new(0, lift, 0)
			return
		end
	end
end)

scripts.title: Moving saw blade
scripts.where: Put this Script inside an Anchored Cylinder Part (the saw) standing on its edge.
scripts.about: The saw spins fast and slides back and forth, resetting anyone it touches.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local SLIDE_DISTANCE = 16 -- how far it slides each way (studs)
local SLIDE_SPEED = 1 -- bigger = faster sliding
local SPIN_SPEED = 720 -- degrees per second

local saw = script.Parent
saw.Anchored = true
local start = saw.CFrame
local spin = 0

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
	spin = (spin + SPIN_SPEED * deltaTime) % 360
	-- Slide along the saw's front direction using a smooth sine wave
	local offset = math.sin(os.clock() * SLIDE_SPEED) * SLIDE_DISTANCE
	-- A Roblox cylinder spins around its X axis
	saw.CFrame = start * CFrame.new(0, 0, offset) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(spin), 0, 0)
end)

saw.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	local character = hit.Parent
	if Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character) then
		local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if humanoid then
			humanoid.Health = 0
		end
	end
end)

scripts.title: No jumping zone
scripts.where: Put this Script inside an Anchored, non-colliding Part that covers the area where jumping is not allowed.
scripts.about: Players inside the zone cannot jump until they walk out of it.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local zone = script.Parent
zone.CanCollide = false
local params = OverlapParams.new()
params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { zone }

local blocked = {} -- humanoid -> the jump numbers they had before

while true do
	task.wait(0.2)
	local inside = {}
	for _, part in ipairs(workspace:GetPartsInPart(zone, params)) do
		local humanoid = part.Parent and part.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if humanoid and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(humanoid.Parent) then
			inside[humanoid] = true
		end
	end

	for humanoid in pairs(inside) do
		if not blocked[humanoid] then
			blocked[humanoid] = { humanoid.JumpHeight, humanoid.JumpPower }
			humanoid.JumpHeight = 0
			humanoid.JumpPower = 0 -- for games that use JumpPower instead
		end
	end

	for humanoid, old in pairs(blocked) do
		if not inside[humanoid] then
			if humanoid.Parent then
				humanoid.JumpHeight = old[1]
				humanoid.JumpPower = old[2]
			end
			blocked[humanoid] = nil
		end
	end
end

scripts.title: Obby speedrun timer
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService, then add two Anchored Parts to Workspace named TimerStart and TimerFinish.
scripts.about: Starts a stopwatch when you touch the start, stops it at the finish and shows your best time on the leaderboard.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local startPart = workspace:WaitForChild("TimerStart")
local finishPart = workspace:WaitForChild("TimerFinish")
local startedAt = {} -- player -> the time they touched the start

-- Make a "Best Time" stat on the leaderboard
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") or Instance.new("Folder")
	leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"
	leaderstats.Parent = player
	local best = Instance.new("NumberValue")
	best.Name = "Best Time"
	best.Value = 0 -- 0 means "no time yet"
	best.Parent = leaderstats
end)

startPart.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
	if player then
		startedAt[player] = os.clock() -- touching the start again restarts the clock
	end
end)

finishPart.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
	if not player or not startedAt[player] then
		return
	end
	local seconds = os.clock() - startedAt[player]
	startedAt[player] = nil
	seconds = math.floor(seconds * 100) / 100 -- keep 2 decimals

	local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local best = stats and stats:FindFirstChild("Best Time")
	if best and (best.Value == 0 or seconds < best.Value) then
		best.Value = seconds
	end
	player:SetAttribute("LastRunTime", seconds) -- a GUI can show this
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	startedAt[player] = nil
end)

scripts.title: Obby stage counter

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: set to true so players can't skip stages
local ONLY_NEXT_STAGE = false

local checkpoints = workspace:WaitForChild("Checkpoints")

-- Make the Stage number on the leaderboard
local function onPlayerAdded(player)
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if not leaderstats then
		leaderstats = Instance.new("Folder")
		leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats" -- must be lowercase like this!
		leaderstats.Parent = player
	end
	local stage = Instance.new("IntValue")
	stage.Name = "Stage"
	stage.Value = 0
	stage.Parent = leaderstats
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
	onPlayerAdded(player)
end

-- Touching a stage part raises your Stage number
local function setupStage(part)
	if not part:IsA("BasePart") then
		return
	end
	part.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
		local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
		local number = tonumber(part.Name)
		local leaderstats = player and player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
		local stage = leaderstats and leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Stage")
		if not stage or not number then
			return
		end
		if ONLY_NEXT_STAGE then
			if number == stage.Value + 1 then
				stage.Value = number
			end
		elseif number > stage.Value then
			stage.Value = number
		end
	end)
end

for _, part in ipairs(checkpoints:GetChildren()) do

end
checkpoints.ChildAdded:Connect(setupStage)

scripts.title: Quicksand pit
scripts.where: Put this Script inside an Anchored Part that covers the quicksand area (turn CanCollide off so players sink into it).
scripts.about: Players inside the quicksand move slowly, can barely jump and lose health until they get out.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local SLOW_SPEED = 4 -- walk speed while inside
local SLOW_JUMP = 2 -- jump height while inside
local DAMAGE_PER_SECOND = 5 -- set to 0 for no damage

local zone = script.Parent
local params = OverlapParams.new()
params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { zone }

local stuck = {} -- humanoid -> {speed, jump} we must give back later

while true do
	task.wait(0.25)
	-- Find every humanoid with a body part inside the zone
	local inside = {}
	for _, part in ipairs(workspace:GetPartsInPart(zone, params)) do
		local humanoid = part.Parent and part.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if humanoid and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(humanoid.Parent) then
			inside[humanoid] = true
		end
	end

	-- Slow down everyone inside
	for humanoid in pairs(inside) do
		if not stuck[humanoid] then
			stuck[humanoid] = { humanoid.WalkSpeed, humanoid.JumpHeight }
		end
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = SLOW_SPEED
		humanoid.JumpHeight = SLOW_JUMP
		humanoid:TakeDamage(DAMAGE_PER_SECOND * 0.25)
	end

	-- Give speed back to anyone who escaped
	for humanoid, saved in pairs(stuck) do
		if not inside[humanoid] then
			if humanoid.Parent then
				humanoid.WalkSpeed = saved[1]
				humanoid.JumpHeight = saved[2]
			end
			stuck[humanoid] = nil
		end
	end
end

	local z = (math.random() - 0.5) * floor.Size.Z
	local spot = (floor.CFrame * CFrame.new(x, floor.Size.Y / 2, z)).Position

	-- A flat red circle warns players

			hurt[humanoid] = true

scripts.title: Random maze generator
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService and add an Anchored Part named MazeCorner in Workspace where the maze should start (its corner).
scripts.about: Builds a brand new random maze out of wall parts every time the server starts.
scripts.code:
-- Settings: change these numbers!
local WIDTH = 12 -- cells across
local HEIGHT = 12 -- cells deep
local CELL = 12 -- studs per cell
local WALL_HEIGHT = 10
local WALL_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(70, 120, 70)

local corner = workspace:WaitForChild("MazeCorner")
local origin = corner.Position

-- walls[x][y] = {N=true, E=true, S=true, W=true} means that wall is still standing
local walls, visited = {}, {}
for x = 1, WIDTH do
	walls[x], visited[x] = {}, {}
	for y = 1, HEIGHT do
		walls[x][y] = { N = true, E = true, S = true, W = true }
	end
end

local moves = { { 0, -1, "N", "S" }, { 1, 0, "E", "W" }, { 0, 1, "S", "N" }, { -1, 0, "W", "E" } }

-- "Recursive backtracker": walk randomly, knocking down walls, and back up at dead ends
local stack = { { 1, 1 } }
visited[1][1] = true
while #stack > 0 do
	local x, y = stack[#stack][1], stack[#stack][2]
	local options = {}
	for _, m in ipairs(moves) do
		local nx, ny = x + m[1], y + m[2]
		if nx >= 1 and nx <= WIDTH and ny >= 1 and ny <= HEIGHT and not visited[nx][ny] then
			table.insert(options, m)
		end
	end
	if #options == 0 then
		table.remove(stack)
	else
		local m = options[math.random(#options)]
		local nx, ny = x + m[1], y + m[2]
		walls[x][y][m[3]] = false
		walls[nx][ny][m[4]] = false
		visited[nx][ny] = true
		table.insert(stack, { nx, ny })
	end
end

-- Open an entrance and an exit
walls[1][1].W = false
walls[WIDTH][HEIGHT].E = false

-- Build the walls as parts
local model = Instance.new("Model")
model.Name = "Maze"
local function wall(position, size)
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Anchored = true
	part.Size = size
	part.Position = origin + position + Vector3.new(0, WALL_HEIGHT / 2, 0)
	part.Color = WALL_COLOR
	part.Parent = model
end
for x = 1, WIDTH do
	for y = 1, HEIGHT do
		local cx, cz = (x - 0.5) * CELL, (y - 0.5) * CELL
		local w = walls[x][y]
		if w.N then wall(Vector3.new(cx, 0, cz - CELL / 2), Vector3.new(CELL + 1, WALL_HEIGHT, 1)) end
		if w.W then wall(Vector3.new(cx - CELL / 2, 0, cz), Vector3.new(1, WALL_HEIGHT, CELL + 1)) end
		if y == HEIGHT and w.S then wall(Vector3.new(cx, 0, cz + CELL / 2), Vector3.new(CELL + 1, WALL_HEIGHT, 1)) end
		if x == WIDTH and w.E then wall(Vector3.new(cx + CELL / 2, 0, cz), Vector3.new(1, WALL_HEIGHT, CELL + 1)) end
	end
end
model.Parent = workspace

scripts.title: Rising lava
