scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local RISE_SPEED = 2 -- studs per second (bigger = faster)
local RISE_HEIGHT = 100 -- how many studs the lava climbs
local WAIT_AT_TOP = 5 -- seconds it stays at the top
local WAIT_AT_BOTTOM = 5 -- seconds before it rises again

local lava = script.Parent
lava.Anchored = true
local startCFrame = lava.CFrame

-- Touching the lava resets the player
lava.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	local character = hit.Parent
	if not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character) then
		return
	end
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
		humanoid.Health = 0
	end
end)

while true do
	task.wait(WAIT_AT_BOTTOM)

	-- Rise a little bit every frame
	local risen = 0
	while risen < RISE_HEIGHT do
		local dt = RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
		risen = math.min(risen + RISE_SPEED * dt, RISE_HEIGHT)
		lava.CFrame = startCFrame + Vector3.new(0, risen, 0)
	end

	task.wait(WAIT_AT_TOP)
	lava.CFrame = startCFrame -- back to the bottom
end

scripts.title: Slippery ice floor
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterCharacterScripts, then set the Material of any floor part to Ice.
scripts.about: Any part made of Ice becomes slippery, so players slide around and find it hard to stop.
scripts.code:
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local GRIP = 1.5 -- smaller = more slippery (try 0.5 to 3)

local character = script.Parent
local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

local slideVelocity = Vector3.zero -- the speed we keep while sliding

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
	local velocity = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
	local flat = Vector3.new(velocity.X, 0, velocity.Z)

	-- FloorMaterial tells us what we are standing on
	if humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Ice or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		slideVelocity = flat -- not on ice: just remember our speed
		return
	end

	-- Where the player WANTS to go
	local wanted = humanoid.MoveDirection * humanoid.WalkSpeed
	-- Slowly turn our sliding speed toward where we want to go
	local alpha = math.clamp(GRIP * deltaTime, 0, 1)
	slideVelocity = slideVelocity:Lerp(wanted, alpha)
	root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(slideVelocity.X, velocity.Y, slideVelocity.Z)
end)

scripts.title: Swinging pendulum blade

scripts.about: Swings the part back and forth like a pendulum and hurts players it hits.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local ROPE_LENGTH = 12 -- studs from the blade up to the swing point
local MAX_ANGLE = 60 -- how far it swings to each side (degrees)
local SPEED = 1.5 -- bigger = faster swings
local DAMAGE = 100 -- 100 = instant reset
local HIT_COOLDOWN = 1 -- seconds before the same player can be hit again

local blade = script.Parent
blade.Anchored = true

-- The swing point is straight above where the blade starts
local pivot = blade.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, ROPE_LENGTH, 0)
local startTime = os.clock()

-- Every frame, work out the new angle with math.sin (it goes smoothly from -1 to 1)
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	local t = os.clock() - startTime
	local angle = math.rad(MAX_ANGLE) * math.sin(t * SPEED)
	blade.CFrame = pivot * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, angle) * CFrame.new(0, -ROPE_LENGTH, 0)
end)

-- Hurt players that get hit
local lastHit = {}
blade.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	local character = hit.Parent
	local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not player or not humanoid then
		return
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - (lastHit[player] or 0) < HIT_COOLDOWN then
		return
	end
	lastHit[player] = now
	humanoid:TakeDamage(DAMAGE)
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	lastHit[player] = nil
end)

local MAX_TILT = 35 -- most it can tip (degrees)

local open = hinge * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(-90)) * CFrame.new(door.Size.X / 2, 0, 0)

scripts.title: Wind zone that pushes you
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterCharacterScripts, then make a Folder named WindZones in Workspace with invisible, non-colliding Parts inside (the front face of each part points where the wind blows).
scripts.about: Players standing inside a wind zone get pushed the way the part is facing.
scripts.code:
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

-- Settings: change this number! (each part can also have a number Attribute named Strength)
local DEFAULT_STRENGTH = 40 -- how hard the wind pushes

local character = script.Parent
local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local windZones = workspace:WaitForChild("WindZones")

-- Is a point inside a (possibly rotated) part?
local function isInside(part, point)
	local localPoint = part.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(point)
	local half = part.Size / 2
	return math.abs(localPoint.X) <= half.X and math.abs(localPoint.Y) <= half.Y and math.abs(localPoint.Z) <= half.Z
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
	for _, zone in ipairs(windZones:GetChildren()) do
		if zone:IsA("BasePart") and isInside(zone, root.Position) then
			local strength = zone:GetAttribute("Strength") or DEFAULT_STRENGTH
			-- Add a little speed every frame in the direction the zone faces
			root.AssemblyLinearVelocity += zone.CFrame.LookVector * strength * deltaTime
		end
	end
end)

end)

scripts.title: Leaderstats with saving
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService, and to test saving in Studio turn on Game Settings > Security > Enable Studio Access to API Services.
scripts.about: Adds a Coins number to the leaderboard and saves it, so players keep their coins next time they play.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

-- Settings: change these!
local STAT_NAME = "Coins" -- the name shown on the leaderboard
local START_AMOUNT = 0 -- coins a brand new player gets
local AUTOSAVE_EVERY = 120 -- seconds between autosaves

local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerCoins_v1")
local loaded = {} -- only save players whose coins loaded fine, so we never wipe them

local function onPlayerAdded(player)
	-- The folder MUST be named "leaderstats" (all lowercase)
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") or Instance.new("Folder")
	leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"
	leaderstats.Parent = player
	local stat = Instance.new("IntValue")
	stat.Name = STAT_NAME
	stat.Value = START_AMOUNT
	stat.Parent = leaderstats

	-- Load saved coins (pcall stops errors from breaking the script)
	local ok, saved = pcall(function()
		return store:GetAsync("Player_" .. player.UserId)
	end)
	if ok and player.Parent then
		if typeof(saved) == "number" then
			stat.Value = saved
		end
		loaded[player] = true
	elseif not ok then
		warn("Could not load coins for " .. player.Name .. ": " .. tostring(saved))
	end
end

local function save(player)
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local stat = leaderstats and leaderstats:FindFirstChild(STAT_NAME)
	if not loaded[player] or not stat then return end
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		store:SetAsync("Player_" .. player.UserId, stat.Value)
	end)
	if not ok then
		warn("Could not save coins for " .. player.Name .. ": " .. tostring(err))
	end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
	task.spawn(onPlayerAdded, player)
end

-- Save when a player leaves
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	save(player)
	loaded[player] = nil
end)

-- Save everyone when the server shuts down
game:BindToClose(function()
	local left = 0
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		left = left + 1
		task.spawn(function()
			save(player)
			left = left - 1
		end)
	end
	while left > 0 do task.wait() end
end)

-- Autosave every few minutes, just in case
while true do
	task.wait(AUTOSAVE_EVERY)
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		task.spawn(save, player)
	end
end

scripts.title: Shop (server part)
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService, add a RemoteEvent named BuyItem to ReplicatedStorage, and put your Tools in a Folder named ShopItems in ServerStorage.
scripts.about: Checks a player has enough coins, takes them, and gives the Tool they bought (use it with the Shop button script).
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")

-- Settings: item names and prices (each name must match a Tool in ShopItems)
local PRICES = {
	["Sword"] = 50,
	["Speed Coil"] = 100,
}
local STAT_NAME = "Coins"
local COOLDOWN = 1 -- seconds between buys (stops button spamming)

local buyItem = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("BuyItem")
local shopItems = ServerStorage:WaitForChild("ShopItems")
local lastBuy = {}

-- Does the player already own this tool?
local function ownsTool(player, name)
	local gear = player:FindFirstChild("StarterGear")
	local backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
	local character = player.Character
	return (gear and gear:FindFirstChild(name))
		or (backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild(name))
		or (character and character:FindFirstChild(name))
end

buyItem.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, itemName)
	-- Never trust the client: the server checks everything!
	if typeof(itemName) ~= "string" then
		return
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if lastBuy[player] and now - lastBuy[player] < COOLDOWN then
		return
	end
	lastBuy[player] = now

	local price = PRICES[itemName]
	local tool = shopItems:FindFirstChild(itemName)
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local coins = leaderstats and leaderstats:FindFirstChild(STAT_NAME)
	if not price or not tool or not coins then
		buyItem:FireClient(player, itemName, false, "Not for sale")
	elseif ownsTool(player, itemName) then
		buyItem:FireClient(player, itemName, false, "You have it!")
	elseif coins.Value < price then
		buyItem:FireClient(player, itemName, false, "Need " .. price .. " coins")
	else
		-- Take the coins and give the tool (StarterGear keeps it after you respawn)
		coins.Value = coins.Value - price
		local backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
		if backpack then
			tool:Clone().Parent = backpack
		end
		local gear = player:FindFirstChild("StarterGear")
		if gear then
			tool:Clone().Parent = gear
		end
		buyItem:FireClient(player, itemName, true, "Bought!")
	end
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	lastBuy[player] = nil
end)

scripts.title: AFK detector (client part)
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts, and add the AFK tag (server part) script too.
scripts.about: Notices when you have not touched any controls for a while (or left the window) and tells the server you are AFK.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

-- Settings: change this number!
local AFK_AFTER = 60 -- seconds with no input before you count as AFK

local setAfk = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("SetAFK")
local lastInput = os.clock()
local isAfk = false
local focused = true

local function setState(afk)
	if afk ~= isAfk then
		isAfk = afk
		setAfk:FireServer(afk)
	end
end

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function()
	lastInput = os.clock()
	setState(false)
end)
UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
		lastInput = os.clock()
	end
end)
-- Clicking away from the Roblox window counts as AFK straight away
UserInputService.WindowFocusReleased:Connect(function()
	focused = false
	setState(true)
end)
UserInputService.WindowFocused:Connect(function()
	focused = true
	lastInput = os.clock()
	setState(false)
end)

while true do
	task.wait(2)
	if focused then
		setState(os.clock() - lastInput > AFK_AFTER)
	end
end

scripts.title: Bonus coins for playing with friends
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService (needs a Coins stat, like from the Leaderstats with saving script).
scripts.about: Every minute, players get bonus coins for each Roblox friend who is in the same server.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local COINS_PER_FRIEND = 5
local EVERY = 60 -- seconds
local MAX_FRIENDS_COUNTED = 5

-- Count how many of this player's friends are in the server
local function countFriends(player)
	local count = 0
	for _, other in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if other ~= player then
			local ok, isFriend = pcall(function()
				return player:IsFriendsWith(other.UserId)
			end)
			if ok and isFriend then
				count = count + 1
			end
		end
	end
	return math.min(count, MAX_FRIENDS_COUNTED)
end

while true do
	task.wait(EVERY)
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
		local coins = stats and stats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
		local friends = countFriends(player)
		player:SetAttribute("FriendsHere", friends) -- a GUI can show this
		if coins and friends > 0 then
			coins.Value = coins.Value + friends * COINS_PER_FRIEND
		end
	end
end

scripts.title: Character grows as you level up

scripts.about: Your character gets a little bigger every level, like in a simulator game.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local STAT_NAME = "Level"
local GROW_PER_LEVEL = 0.05 -- 5 percent bigger each level
local MAX_SCALE = 3

local function resize(player)
	local character = player.Character
	local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local level = stats and stats:FindFirstChild(STAT_NAME)
	if not character or not level or not character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
		return
	end
	local scale = math.clamp(1 + (level.Value - 1) * GROW_PER_LEVEL, 0.5, MAX_SCALE)
	if math.abs(character:GetScale() - scale) > 0.001 then

	end

		character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		task.wait(0.1)
		resize(player)

	local stats = player:WaitForChild("leaderstats", 30)
	local level = stats and stats:WaitForChild(STAT_NAME, 30)
	if level then
		level.Changed:Connect(function()
			resize(player)
		end)
	end
end)

scripts.code:
local ContextActionService = game:GetService("ContextActionService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local CAMERA_DROP = 1.5 -- how many studs the camera goes down
local CROUCH_ANIMATION_ID = "" -- like "rbxassetid://1234567" (leave empty for no animation)

local character = script.Parent

local crouching = false

if CROUCH_ANIMATION_ID ~= "" then

scripts.title: Custom health regen

scripts.about: Heals players a little every second, but only after they have not been hurt for a few seconds.
scripts.code:
-- Settings: change these numbers!
local HEAL_PER_SECOND = 3 -- health back each second
local WAIT_AFTER_HIT = 4 -- seconds after getting hurt before healing starts

local character = script.Parent
local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local lastHealth = humanoid.Health
local lastHurt = 0

-- Remember when we last lost health
humanoid.HealthChanged:Connect(function(health)
	if health < lastHealth then
		lastHurt = os.clock()
	end
	lastHealth = health
end)

while humanoid.Health > 0 do
	task.wait(1)
	if os.clock() - lastHurt >= WAIT_AFTER_HIT and humanoid.Health < humanoid.MaxHealth and humanoid.Health > 0 then
		humanoid.Health = math.min(humanoid.Health + HEAL_PER_SECOND, humanoid.MaxHealth)
		lastHealth = humanoid.Health
	end
end

scripts.title: Dash forward
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterCharacterScripts.
scripts.about: Press Q (or the Dash button on phones) to zoom forward quickly, with a short cooldown.
scripts.code:
local ContextActionService = game:GetService("ContextActionService")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local DASH_SPEED = 90
local COOLDOWN = 1.5 -- seconds between dashes

local character = script.Parent
local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local lastDash = 0

local function dash(_, state)
	if state ~= Enum.UserInputState.Begin then
		return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
	end
	if os.clock() - lastDash < COOLDOWN or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
	end
	lastDash = os.clock()

	-- Dash the way we are walking, or the way we face if standing still
	local direction = humanoid.MoveDirection
	if direction.Magnitude < 0.1 then
		direction = root.CFrame.LookVector
	end
	direction = Vector3.new(direction.X, 0, direction.Z).Unit
	root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = direction * DASH_SPEED + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0)
	return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
end

ContextActionService:BindAction("Dash", dash, true, Enum.KeyCode.Q)
ContextActionService:SetTitle("Dash", "Dash")

humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
	ContextActionService:UnbindAction("Dash")
end)

scripts.title: Double jump
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterCharacterScripts.
scripts.about: Lets players jump a second time while they are in the air (works with the jump button on phones and iPads too).
scripts.code:
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local DOUBLE_JUMP_POWER = 50 -- how high the second jump goes
local DELAY = 0.2 -- seconds after leaving the ground before you can jump again

local character = script.Parent
local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

local leftGroundAt = nil -- when we left the ground
local usedDoubleJump = false

-- Keep track of when we are on the ground or in the air
humanoid.StateChanged:Connect(function(_, newState)
	if newState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed
		or newState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running
		or newState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing
		or newState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming then
		leftGroundAt = nil
		usedDoubleJump = false
	elseif newState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall or newState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping then
		if not leftGroundAt then
			leftGroundAt = os.clock()
		end
	end
end)

-- When the player presses jump in the air, jump again (only once!)
UserInputService.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
	if usedDoubleJump or not leftGroundAt then
		return
	end
	if os.clock() - leftGroundAt < DELAY then
		return
	end
	if humanoid:GetState() ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall then
		return
	end

	usedDoubleJump = true
	humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
	local velocity = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
	root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(velocity.X, DOUBLE_JUMP_POWER, velocity.Z)
end)

scripts.about: Press 1, 2, 3 or 4 to play a dance or emote animation; moving stops it.
scripts.code:
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

-- Settings: put your own animation ids here (animations must be owned by you or your group)
local EMOTES = {
	[Enum.KeyCode.One] = "rbxassetid://507771019", -- Roblox dance 1
	[Enum.KeyCode.Two] = "rbxassetid://507776043", -- Roblox dance 2
	[Enum.KeyCode.Three] = "rbxassetid://507777268", -- Roblox dance 3
	[Enum.KeyCode.Four] = "rbxassetid://507770239", -- Roblox wave
}

local character = script.Parent
local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local animator = humanoid:WaitForChild("Animator")

-- Load every animation once so they start instantly
local tracks = {}
for key, id in pairs(EMOTES) do
	local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
	animation.AnimationId = id
	tracks[key] = animator:LoadAnimation(animation)
	tracks[key].Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
end

local playing = nil

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, typing)
	if typing then
		return -- do not dance while typing in chat!
	end
	local track = tracks[input.KeyCode]
	if not track then
		return
	end
	if playing then
		playing:Stop()
	end
	if playing == track then
		playing = nil -- pressing the same key again stops it
	else
		track:Play()
		playing = track
	end
end)

-- Walking cancels the emote
humanoid:GetPropertyChangedSignal("MoveDirection"):Connect(function()
	if playing and humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then
		playing:Stop()
		playing = nil
	end
end)

scripts.title: Fall damage
scripts.where: Put this Script in StarterPlayer > StarterCharacterScripts.
scripts.about: Players get hurt when they land after falling really fast; the faster they fell, the more it hurts.
scripts.code:
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local SAFE_SPEED = 60 -- falling slower than this never hurts
local DAMAGE_PER_SPEED = 1.2 -- damage for every unit of speed over the safe speed

local character = script.Parent
local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local fastestFall = 0

local connection
connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	if humanoid.Health <= 0 or not root.Parent then
		connection:Disconnect()
		return
	end
	local downSpeed = -root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y
	if downSpeed > 10 then
		-- Falling: remember the fastest we fell
		fastestFall = math.max(fastestFall, downSpeed)
	elseif downSpeed < 3 and fastestFall > 0 then
		-- We suddenly stopped falling, so we just landed!
		if fastestFall > SAFE_SPEED then
			humanoid:TakeDamage((fastestFall - SAFE_SPEED) * DAMAGE_PER_SPEED)
		end
		fastestFall = 0
	end
end)

scripts.title: Fly with a key
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterCharacterScripts.
scripts.about: Press F (or the Fly button on phones) to fly where your camera points; Space goes up and Ctrl goes down.
scripts.code:
local ContextActionService = game:GetService("ContextActionService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local FLY_SPEED = 50
local UP_DOWN_SPEED = 30

local character = script.Parent
local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local attachment = root:WaitForChild("RootAttachment")
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local flying = false

-- LinearVelocity moves us, AlignOrientation turns us to face the camera
local mover = Instance.new("LinearVelocity")
mover.Attachment0 = attachment
mover.MaxForce = math.huge
mover.Enabled = false
mover.Parent = root
local turner = Instance.new("AlignOrientation")
turner.Mode = Enum.OrientationAlignmentMode.OneAttachment
turner.Attachment0 = attachment
turner.Responsiveness = 20
turner.MaxTorque = math.huge
turner.Enabled = false
turner.Parent = root

local function toggleFly(_, state)
	if state ~= Enum.UserInputState.Begin then
		return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
	end
	flying = not flying
	mover.Enabled = flying
	turner.Enabled = flying
	humanoid.PlatformStand = flying -- stops the walking animation fighting us
	return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
end
-- true = also make a button on phones and tablets
ContextActionService:BindAction("Fly", toggleFly, true, Enum.KeyCode.F)
ContextActionService:SetTitle("Fly", "Fly")

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	if not flying then
		return
	end
	local velocity = humanoid.MoveDirection * FLY_SPEED
	-- Flying forward while looking up or down also moves you up or down
	local look = camera.CFrame.LookVector
	local flatLook = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
	if flatLook.Magnitude > 0.01 then
		local forwardAmount = humanoid.MoveDirection:Dot(flatLook.Unit)
		velocity += Vector3.new(0, look.Y * FLY_SPEED * forwardAmount, 0)
		turner.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero, flatLook)
	end
	if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then
		velocity += Vector3.new(0, UP_DOWN_SPEED, 0)
	elseif UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then
		velocity -= Vector3.new(0, UP_DOWN_SPEED, 0)
	end
	mover.VectorVelocity = velocity
end)

humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
	ContextActionService:UnbindAction("Fly")
end)

scripts.title: Game pass speed boost
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService and put your game pass id below.
scripts.about: Players who own your game pass run faster, and it works right away if they buy it during the game.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")

-- Settings: change these!
local GAME_PASS_ID = 0 -- your game pass id from the Creator Hub
local BOOST_SPEED = 32

local owners = {}

local function giveSpeed(player)
	local humanoid = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if owners[player] and humanoid then
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = BOOST_SPEED
	end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)

	local ok, owns = pcall(function()
		return MarketplaceService:UserOwnsGamePassAsync(player.UserId, GAME_PASS_ID)
	end)

		character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

	end)
	giveSpeed(player)
end)

-- Bought it in game? Give the boost now

	if purchased and passId == GAME_PASS_ID then

scripts.title: Healing pad
scripts.where: Put this Script inside the Part you want to heal players.
scripts.about: Gives players health back when they touch it, with a wait before it works again.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local HEAL_AMOUNT = 25 -- health given each time
local COOLDOWN = 5 -- seconds before the same player can heal again

local pad = script.Parent
local lastHeal = {} -- when each player last healed

pad.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	local character = hit.Parent
	local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
	if not player then
		return
	end

	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	-- Skip if they're gone, or already at full health
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or humanoid.Health >= humanoid.MaxHealth then
		return
	end

	-- Still cooling down? Not yet!
	local now = os.clock()
	if lastHeal[player] and now - lastHeal[player] < COOLDOWN then
		return
	end
	lastHeal[player] = now

	-- Heal, but never above max health
	humanoid.Health = math.min(humanoid.Health + HEAL_AMOUNT, humanoid.MaxHealth)
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	lastHeal[player] = nil
end)

scripts.title: Hunger system
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService; to make food, give any Tool a number Attribute named Food (how much it fills you up).
scripts.about: Players slowly get hungry, lose health when starving, and fill up by using food Tools.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local MAX_HUNGER = 100
local HUNGER_LOSS = 1 -- lost every few seconds
local LOSS_EVERY = 3 -- seconds
local STARVE_DAMAGE = 5 -- health lost each tick at 0 hunger

local function hookFood(player, tool)
	if not tool:IsA("Tool") or not tool:GetAttribute("Food") then
		return
	end
	-- Activated fires on the server when the player clicks with the tool
	tool.Activated:Connect(function()
		local hunger = player.leaderstats.Hunger
		hunger.Value = math.min(hunger.Value + tool:GetAttribute("Food"), MAX_HUNGER)
		tool:Destroy() -- eaten!
	end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") or Instance.new("Folder")
	leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"
	leaderstats.Parent = player
	local hunger = Instance.new("IntValue")
	hunger.Name = "Hunger"
	hunger.Value = MAX_HUNGER
	hunger.Parent = leaderstats

	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
		hunger.Value = MAX_HUNGER -- full again after respawning
		character.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
			if child:IsA("Tool") and not child:GetAttribute("HungerHooked") then
				child:SetAttribute("HungerHooked", true)
				hookFood(player, child)
			end
		end)
	end)
end)

while true do
	task.wait(LOSS_EVERY)
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
		local hunger = stats and stats:FindFirstChild("Hunger")
		local humanoid = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if hunger and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
			hunger.Value = math.max(hunger.Value - HUNGER_LOSS, 0)
			if hunger.Value == 0 then
				humanoid:TakeDamage(STARVE_DAMAGE)
			end
		end
	end
end

	for _, thing in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		if thing:IsA("BasePart") and thing.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
			thing.Transparency = visible and 0 or 1
		elseif thing:IsA("Decal") then -- the face

		end

	end

	local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
	if not player or recent[player] then
		return

	recent[player] = true
	setVisible(character, false)

end)

local character = script.Parent
local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

-- Do not fall apart, we will make the joints floppy instead
humanoid.BreakJointsOnDeath = false

humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
	for _, joint in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		if joint:IsA("Motor6D") and joint.Part0 and joint.Part1 then
			-- Make two attachments in the same spots the motor used
			local a0 = Instance.new("Attachment")
			a0.CFrame = joint.C0
			a0.Parent = joint.Part0
			local a1 = Instance.new("Attachment")
			a1.CFrame = joint.C1
			a1.Parent = joint.Part1

			-- A ball socket lets the limb swing around loosely
			local socket = Instance.new("BallSocketConstraint")
			socket.Attachment0 = a0
			socket.Attachment1 = a1
			socket.LimitsEnabled = true
			socket.TwistLimitsEnabled = true
			socket.Parent = joint.Parent

			joint.Enabled = false
		end
	end

	-- Let the limbs bump into the floor instead of sinking through it
	for _, part in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
			part.CanCollide = true
		end
	end
end)

scripts.title: Run out of air underwater
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService (it works with Terrain water).
scripts.about: Players have limited air when their head is under Terrain water and start losing health when it runs out.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local MAX_AIR = 15 -- seconds of air
local DROWN_DAMAGE = 10 -- health lost each second with no air

local terrain = workspace.Terrain

-- Is this spot inside Terrain water?
local function isInWater(position)
	local region = Region3.new(position - Vector3.new(2, 2, 2), position + Vector3.new(2, 2, 2)):ExpandToGrid(4)
	local materials = terrain:ReadVoxels(region, 4)
	return materials[1][1][1] == Enum.Material.Water
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	player:SetAttribute("Air", MAX_AIR)
end)

while true do
	task.wait(1)
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local character = player.Character
		local head = character and character:FindFirstChild("Head")
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if head and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
			local air = player:GetAttribute("Air") or MAX_AIR
			if isInWater(head.Position) then
				air = math.max(air - 1, 0)
				if air == 0 then
					humanoid:TakeDamage(DROWN_DAMAGE)
				end
			else
				air = math.min(air + 3, MAX_AIR) -- breathe again quickly
			end
			-- A GUI can read the "Air" attribute to show bubbles
			player:SetAttribute("Air", air)
		end
	end
end

scripts.title: Slide while running
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterCharacterScripts.
scripts.about: While running, press Left Ctrl (or the Slide button) to slide along the ground fast and low.
scripts.code:
local ContextActionService = game:GetService("ContextActionService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local SLIDE_SPEED = 60
local SLIDE_TIME = 0.6 -- seconds
local COOLDOWN = 1.2

local character = script.Parent
local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local lastSlide = 0

local function slide(_, state)
	if state ~= Enum.UserInputState.Begin then
		return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
	end
	-- Must be moving and on the ground
	if humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude < 0.1 or humanoid.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air then
		return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
	end
	if os.clock() - lastSlide < COOLDOWN then
		return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
	end
	lastSlide = os.clock()

	local direction = humanoid.MoveDirection.Unit
	humanoid.CameraOffset = Vector3.new(0, -1.5, 0) -- camera goes low
	-- task.spawn runs the slide on its own, so the key handler can finish straight away
	task.spawn(function()
		local endTime = os.clock() + SLIDE_TIME
		while os.clock() < endTime and humanoid.Health > 0 do
			-- Slow down a little as the slide goes on
			local left = (endTime - os.clock()) / SLIDE_TIME
			local y = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y
			root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = direction * (SLIDE_SPEED * left + humanoid.WalkSpeed) + Vector3.new(0, y, 0)
			task.wait()
		end
		TweenService:Create(humanoid, TweenInfo.new(0.2), { CameraOffset = Vector3.zero }):Play()
	end)
	return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
end

ContextActionService:BindAction("Slide", slide, true, Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl)
ContextActionService:SetTitle("Slide", "Slide")
humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
	ContextActionService:UnbindAction("Slide")
end)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change these!
local STAT_NAME = "Wins"
local WINS_NEEDED = 10
local AURA_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(255, 230, 120)

local function updateAura(player)
	local character = player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local wins = stats and stats:FindFirstChild(STAT_NAME)
	if not root or not wins then
		return
	end
	local aura = root:FindFirstChild("Aura")
	if wins.Value >= WINS_NEEDED and not aura then
		aura = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
		aura.Name = "Aura"
		aura.Color = ColorSequence.new(AURA_COLOR)
		aura.LightEmission = 1
		aura.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.4, 0)
		aura.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.8, 1.2)
		aura.Rate = 25
		aura.Speed = NumberRange.new(1, 3)
		aura.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
		aura.Parent = root
	elseif wins.Value < WINS_NEEDED and aura then
		aura:Destroy()

end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
		character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		updateAura(player)
	end)
	-- When the Wins number changes, check again
	local stats = player:WaitForChild("leaderstats", 30)
	local wins = stats and stats:WaitForChild(STAT_NAME, 30)

end)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

	local spots = {}
	for _, part in ipairs(spawnPoints:GetChildren()) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then
			table.insert(spots, part)
		end
	end
	if #spots == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	return spots[math.random(#spots)]
end

local function onCharacterAdded(character)
	character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	task.wait() -- wait one frame so Roblox finishes placing the character
	local spot = pickSpot()
	if spot then
		-- Stand on top of the spot part
		character:PivotTo(spot.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, spot.Size.Y / 2 + 3, 0))
	end
end

scripts.title: Spawn protection bubble
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService.

scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local PROTECT_SECONDS = 8
local LEAVE_DISTANCE = 30 -- walking this far from where you spawned ends it early

local function onCharacterAdded(character)
	local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	task.wait() -- let the character get placed on its spawn first
	local spawnPosition = root.Position

	local shield = Instance.new("ForceField")
	shield.Visible = true
	shield.Parent = character -- a ForceField stops all damage from TakeDamage

	local endTime = os.clock() + PROTECT_SECONDS
	while shield.Parent and os.clock() < endTime do
		if (root.Position - spawnPosition).Magnitude > LEAVE_DISTANCE then
			break
		end
		task.wait(0.25)
	end
	shield:Destroy()
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacterAdded)
end)

scripts.title: Speed pad
scripts.where: Put this Script inside the Part you want to be a speed pad.
scripts.about: Makes players super fast for a few seconds, then back to normal speed.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local BOOST_SPEED = 50 -- speed while boosted
local NORMAL_SPEED = 16 -- normal Roblox speed is 16
local BOOST_TIME = 3 -- seconds the boost lasts

local pad = script.Parent
local boosted = {} -- players who are boosted right now

pad.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	local character = hit.Parent
	local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
	if not player or boosted[player] then
		return
	end

	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		return
	end

	-- Zoom!
	boosted[player] = true
	humanoid.WalkSpeed = BOOST_SPEED

	-- After a few seconds, go back to normal
	task.delay(BOOST_TIME, function()
		if humanoid.Parent then
			humanoid.WalkSpeed = NORMAL_SPEED
		end
		boosted[player] = nil
	end)
end)

scripts.title: Sprint button
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterCharacterScripts.
scripts.about: Hold Shift (or the Run button on phones and iPads) to run faster.
scripts.code:
local ContextActionService = game:GetService("ContextActionService")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local SPRINT_SPEED = 28 -- speed while sprinting
local WALK_SPEED = 16 -- normal speed

local character = script.Parent
local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

-- Runs when the sprint key or button is pressed or let go
local function onSprint(_, inputState)
	if inputState == Enum.UserInputState.Begin then
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = SPRINT_SPEED
	elseif inputState == Enum.UserInputState.End or inputState == Enum.UserInputState.Cancel then
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = WALK_SPEED
	end
	return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
end

-- true = also make a button on touch screens
ContextActionService:BindAction("Sprint", onSprint, true, Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift, Enum.KeyCode.ButtonL3)
ContextActionService:SetTitle("Sprint", "Run")

-- Remove the button when you die (a new one comes when you respawn)
humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
	ContextActionService:UnbindAction("Sprint")
end)

scripts.title: Sprint with a stamina bar
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterCharacterScripts (do not also use the Sprint button script).
scripts.about: Hold Shift to run, but running uses up a stamina bar that refills when you walk.
scripts.code:
local ContextActionService = game:GetService("ContextActionService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local WALK_SPEED = 16
local RUN_SPEED = 28
local MAX_STAMINA = 100
local DRAIN_PER_SECOND = 25
local REFILL_PER_SECOND = 15

local character = script.Parent
local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local stamina = MAX_STAMINA
local wantsToRun = false

-- Build a little bar at the bottom of the screen
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "StaminaGui"
gui.Parent = Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local back = Instance.new("Frame")
back.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
back.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -20)
back.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(240, 14)
back.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
back.Parent = gui
local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
fill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 200, 255)
fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
fill.Parent = back

ContextActionService:BindAction("Run", function(_, state)
	wantsToRun = state == Enum.UserInputState.Begin
	return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
end, true, Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift)
ContextActionService:SetTitle("Run", "Run")

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
	local moving = humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0
	local running = wantsToRun and moving and stamina > 0
	if running then
		stamina = math.max(stamina - DRAIN_PER_SECOND * deltaTime, 0)
	else
		stamina = math.min(stamina + REFILL_PER_SECOND * deltaTime, MAX_STAMINA)
	end
	humanoid.WalkSpeed = running and RUN_SPEED or WALK_SPEED
	fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(stamina / MAX_STAMINA, 1)
end)

humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
	ContextActionService:UnbindAction("Run")
	gui:Destroy()
end)

scripts.title: Teleporter pair
scripts.where: Put this Script inside a Model or Folder in Workspace that holds two parts named TeleportA and TeleportB.
scripts.about: Touching one pad sends you to the other pad, and back again.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change this number!
local COOLDOWN = 2 -- seconds before you can teleport again (stops bouncing back and forth)

local holder = script.Parent
local padA = holder:WaitForChild("TeleportA")
local padB = holder:WaitForChild("TeleportB")
local recent = {} -- players who just teleported

-- Touching fromPad sends you on top of toPad
local function linkPads(fromPad, toPad)
	fromPad.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
		local character = hit.Parent
		local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
		if not player or recent[player] then
			return
		end
		local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
			return
		end

		recent[player] = true
		-- Land a little above the other pad
		local above = toPad.Position + Vector3.new(0, toPad.Size.Y / 2 + 3, 0)
		character:PivotTo(CFrame.new(above))

		task.delay(COOLDOWN, function()
			recent[player] = nil
		end)
	end)
end

linkPads(padA, padB)
linkPads(padB, padA)

scripts.title: Turn off the reset button

-- The Roblox menu might not be ready yet, so keep trying for a few seconds
for _ = 1, 20 do

scripts.title: VIP glow outline
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService and put your VIP game pass id below.
scripts.about: Players who own the VIP game pass get a glowing gold outline around their character.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")

-- Settings: change these!
local VIP_PASS_ID = 0
local GLOW_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 0)

local vips = {}

local function addGlow(character)
	if character:FindFirstChild("VIPGlow") then
		return
	end
	local glow = Instance.new("Highlight")
	glow.Name = "VIPGlow"
	glow.FillTransparency = 1 -- only the outline
	glow.OutlineColor = GLOW_COLOR
	glow.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded -- not visible through walls
	glow.Parent = character
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	local ok, owns = pcall(function()
		return MarketplaceService:UserOwnsGamePassAsync(player.UserId, VIP_PASS_ID)
	end)
	vips[player] = ok and owns
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
		if vips[player] then
			addGlow(character)
		end
	end)
	if vips[player] and player.Character then
		addGlow(player.Character)
	end
end)

MarketplaceService.PromptGamePassPurchaseFinished:Connect(function(player, passId, bought)
	if bought and passId == VIP_PASS_ID then
		vips[player] = true
		if player.Character then
			addGlow(player.Character)
		end
	end
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	vips[player] = nil
end)

scripts.title: Wall jump
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterCharacterScripts.
scripts.about: Jump while in the air next to a wall to kick off it and jump again, like in a parkour game.
scripts.code:
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local UP_POWER = 50
local AWAY_POWER = 35
local WALL_DISTANCE = 2.5 -- how close a wall must be
local COOLDOWN = 0.3

local character = script.Parent
local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local lastWallJump = 0

local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character }

local function findWall()
	-- Look forward, back, left and right for a wall
	local cf = root.CFrame
	local directions = { cf.LookVector, -cf.LookVector, cf.RightVector, -cf.RightVector }
	for _, direction in ipairs(directions) do
		local result = workspace:Raycast(root.Position, direction * (root.Size.X / 2 + WALL_DISTANCE), rayParams)
		if result and math.abs(result.Normal.Y) < 0.3 then -- steep enough to be a wall
			return result.Normal
		end
	end
	return nil
end

UserInputService.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
	if humanoid:GetState() ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall then
		return -- only in the air
	end
	if os.clock() - lastWallJump < COOLDOWN then
		return
	end
	local normal = findWall()
	if normal then
		lastWallJump = os.clock()
		-- Push away from the wall and up
		root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = normal * AWAY_POWER + Vector3.new(0, UP_POWER, 0)
		root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(root.Position, root.Position + Vector3.new(normal.X, 0, normal.Z))
	end
end)

scripts.title: Basic sword
scripts.where: Put this Script inside a Tool that has a part named Handle, then put the Tool in StarterPack.
scripts.about: Click or tap to swing the sword and hurt other players and NPCs it hits (never yourself).
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local DAMAGE = 25 -- health taken per hit
local SWING_TIME = 0.4 -- seconds a swing can hit things
local COOLDOWN = 0.8 -- seconds between swings
local TEAM_DAMAGE = false -- true = you can hurt your own team

local tool = script.Parent
local handle = tool:WaitForChild("Handle")
local swinging = false
local canSwing = true
local hitThisSwing = {} -- each enemy can only be hit once per swing

tool.Activated:Connect(function()
	if not canSwing then
		return
	end
	canSwing = false
	swinging = true
	hitThisSwing = {}

	-- Play Roblox's built-in sword slash animation
	local anim = Instance.new("StringValue")
	anim.Name = "toolanim"
	anim.Value = "Slash"
	anim.Parent = tool

	task.wait(SWING_TIME)
	swinging = false
	task.wait(math.max(COOLDOWN - SWING_TIME, 0))
	canSwing = true
end)

handle.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	if not swinging then
		return
	end
	local owner = tool.Parent -- the character holding the sword
	local character = hit.Parent
	if not character or character == owner then
		return -- no hitting yourself!
	end
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or hitThisSwing[humanoid] then
		return
	end

	-- Skip teammates (only if your game has teams)
	local ownerPlayer = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(owner)
	local victimPlayer = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
	if not TEAM_DAMAGE and ownerPlayer and victimPlayer and victimPlayer.Team ~= nil
		and victimPlayer.Team == ownerPlayer.Team then
		return
	end

	hitThisSwing[humanoid] = true
	humanoid:TakeDamage(DAMAGE)
end)

scripts.title: Click to get a tool
scripts.where: Put this Script inside a Part, and put the Tool you want to give in ServerStorage (set TOOL_NAME to its exact name).
scripts.about: Clicking or tapping the part puts a copy of the tool in the player's backpack.
scripts.code:
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")

-- Settings: change these!
local TOOL_NAME = "Sword" -- the exact name of the Tool in ServerStorage
local CLICK_DISTANCE = 20 -- how close you must be to click it

local part = script.Parent

-- Add a ClickDetector so the part can be clicked or tapped
local clickDetector = part:FindFirstChildOfClass("ClickDetector") or Instance.new("ClickDetector")
clickDetector.MaxActivationDistance = CLICK_DISTANCE
clickDetector.Parent = part

clickDetector.MouseClick:Connect(function(player)
	local tool = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild(TOOL_NAME)
	if not tool then
		warn("Put a Tool named " .. TOOL_NAME .. " in ServerStorage!")
		return
	end

	local backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
	local character = player.Character
	if not backpack then
		return
	end

	-- Only one each, no stacking up copies
	if backpack:FindFirstChild(TOOL_NAME) or (character and character:FindFirstChild(TOOL_NAME)) then
		return
	end

	tool:Clone().Parent = backpack
end)

scripts.title: Day and night cycle
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService.
scripts.about: Makes the sun move across the sky so day turns into night and back again.
scripts.code:
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local DAY_LENGTH = 10 -- minutes for one full day and night
local START_TIME = 8 -- the hour the game starts at (0 = midnight, 12 = noon)
local UPDATE_EVERY = 0.1 -- seconds between updates

Lighting.ClockTime = START_TIME

-- How many in-game hours pass each real second
local hoursPerSecond = 24 / (DAY_LENGTH * 60)

while true do
	local dt = task.wait(UPDATE_EVERY)
	-- Move the clock forward (% 24 makes it go back to 0 after midnight)
	Lighting.ClockTime = (Lighting.ClockTime + hoursPerSecond * dt) % 24
end

scripts.title: NPC that follows players
scripts.where: Put this Script inside an NPC Model that has a Humanoid and a HumanoidRootPart (for example a Rig made with the Rig Builder in the Avatar tab).
scripts.about: The NPC walks after the nearest player, and can hurt them if you turn on TOUCH_DAMAGE.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local PathfindingService = game:GetService("PathfindingService")

-- Settings: change these!
local CHASE_DISTANCE = 100 -- players closer than this get followed
local STOP_DISTANCE = 5 -- stop walking this close to the player
local USE_PATHFINDING = false -- true = walks around walls
local TOUCH_DAMAGE = 0 -- set to 10 to make it a zombie that hurts

local npc = script.Parent
local humanoid = npc:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local root = npc:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
-- Unanchor the NPC so it can walk, and let the server move it smoothly
for _, part in ipairs(npc:GetDescendants()) do
	if part:IsA("BasePart") then
		part.Anchored = false
	end
end
pcall(function() root:SetNetworkOwner(nil) end)

-- Find the closest living player
local function findNearest()
	local nearest, nearestDistance = nil, CHASE_DISTANCE
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local character = player.Character
		local theirRoot = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local theirHumanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if theirRoot and theirHumanoid and theirHumanoid.Health > 0 then
			local distance = (theirRoot.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
			if distance < nearestDistance then
				nearest, nearestDistance = theirRoot, distance
			end
		end
	end
	return nearest, nearestDistance
end

-- Walk toward a spot (around walls if pathfinding is on)
local function walkTo(position)
	if USE_PATHFINDING then
		local path = PathfindingService:CreatePath()
		local ok = pcall(function()
			path:ComputeAsync(root.Position, position)
		end)
		local waypoints = ok and path.Status == Enum.PathStatus.Success and path:GetWaypoints()
		local nextPoint = waypoints and (waypoints[2] or waypoints[1])
		if nextPoint then
			if nextPoint.Action == Enum.PathWaypointAction.Jump then
				humanoid.Jump = true
			end
			humanoid:MoveTo(nextPoint.Position)
			return
		end
	end
	humanoid:MoveTo(position)
end

-- Hurt players it touches (only if TOUCH_DAMAGE is more than 0)
local lastHit = {}
humanoid.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
	local theirHumanoid = player and hit.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local now = os.clock()
	-- Only hurt the same player once per second
	if TOUCH_DAMAGE > 0 and theirHumanoid and now - (lastHit[player] or 0) >= 1 then
		lastHit[player] = now
		theirHumanoid:TakeDamage(TOUCH_DAMAGE)
	end
end)

-- Keep chasing while the NPC is alive
while humanoid.Health > 0 do
	local target, distance = findNearest()
	if target and distance > STOP_DISTANCE then
		walkTo(target.Position)
	end
	task.wait(0.25)
end

scripts.title: Rainbow part
scripts.where: Put this Script inside a Part (or inside a Model to make every part in it rainbow).
scripts.about: Smoothly changes the color through the whole rainbow, over and over.
scripts.code:
-- Settings: change these numbers!
local SPEED = 0.2 -- how fast the colors change (1 = whole rainbow every second)
local SATURATION = 1 -- 0 = grey, 1 = super colorful
local BRIGHTNESS = 1 -- 0 = black, 1 = bright

local target = script.Parent
local hue = 0

-- Color the part, or every part inside the model
local function paint(color)
	if target:IsA("BasePart") then
		target.Color = color
	end
	for _, item in ipairs(target:GetDescendants()) do
		if item:IsA("BasePart") then
			item.Color = color
		end
	end
end

while true do
	local dt = task.wait(0.05)
	hue = (hue + SPEED * dt) % 1
	paint(Color3.fromHSV(hue, SATURATION, BRIGHTNESS))
end

scripts.title: Sound on touch
scripts.where: Put this Script inside a Part, and put a Sound inside the same Part (pick one from the Toolbox or paste a sound ID into its SoundId).
keywords: noise when you step on it
scripts.about: Plays the part's sound when a player touches it.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change this number!
local COOLDOWN = 1 -- seconds before the same player can play it again

local part = script.Parent
local sound = part:FindFirstChildOfClass("Sound")
local lastPlayed = {}

if not sound then
	warn("Put a Sound inside " .. part.Name .. " so it has something to play!")
	return
end

part.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
	if not player then
		return
	end

	-- Wait a bit between plays so it doesn't spam
	local now = os.clock()
	if lastPlayed[player] and now - lastPlayed[player] < COOLDOWN then
		return
	end
	lastPlayed[player] = now

	sound:Play()
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	lastPlayed[player] = nil
end)
